2.name: Aiela
2.look: a gorgeous, dark-haired woman wearing jaguar fur.
2.hello: "The strange warrior $P! Surely he has come to rescue Aiela from her cruel prison!" She looks about fearfully. "Aiela cannot speak to $P now, or Darden's men may hear her and come!" "Yes, my love?" Her face darkens. "Oh. It is $P. $P the mate of Tristia. Tristia's mate $P. What does @Tristia's mate $P want?" "Yes, mighty $P?"

qa.a: "Aiela is my name. Aiela is daughter of @Aloron, the chief of the @Kuraks."
"Yes?"
"Aiela is Princess of the @Kurak tribe, and warrior. Aiela is friend to the jaguar, enemy of the @Myrmidex."
"Aiela's father is Aloron, chief of the @Kurak tribe."
"Aiela loves $P, too. Aiela never tires of hearing $P say this."

"Aiela belongs to the Kurak tribe. Her father @Aloron is chief of the Kuraks. Kuraks know the jungle and the jungle cats." "$P is Aiela's mate, and so $P is also a member of the Kurak tribe." She smiles. "Perhaps someday $P will be chief of Kuraks."

"If $P wants bones, he should go to where the great lizards go to die." "East of the stone city of the @Nahuatla is a great stand of iron bamboo, and north of that is the place where the great lizards go to die." "Many bones are there." "When $P has been @Tristia's mate for a while longer, doubtless he will also feel like lying down among those bones and dying there."

"If $P wants a hide, he must kill a furred creature and then use a knife on its carcass. Lizard hide is too tough to be any use." "A good thing for $P to do with a hide is to make a hide bag and cover the face of his mate @Tristia with it."
"If $P wants iron bamboo, it is easy to find. He must go north of the @Nahuatla stone village, or south of the @Yolaru village, and near the eastern cliffs he will find a great stand of bamboo."

"The Myrmidex! They are evil. Ants of the jungle, but larger than men. No single tribe can stand against them. And yet the tribes will not @unite against them." "$P has chosen @Tristia as his mate. He must have much in common with the Myrmidex. Perhaps he should go join them."
"Sahree is a warrior-woman of the @Yolaru. Sahree and Aiela are friends and allies." She adds, playfully: "Sahree is very beautiful, but $P must keep his eyes to Aiela, not Sahree."
"Aiela has heard the name of Topuru. Topuru is a mad shaman, once of the @Urali. Topuru lives on an island, all alone, in the north somewhere."
"The Urali are a suspicious tribe. They hide away from the other tribes. Few ever tell their true names." "Now that @Darden is dead, their chief is Wamap, who is also their shaman."

"Darden thought he could buy Aiela's love with a giant gem, stolen from the @Nahuatla. But Aiela could never love one so cruel as Darden." She pauses, and grins. "But Aiela did keep the gem. It is very pretty!"
"The Yolaru are a strong, noble tribe east of the @Kuraks. Their chief is Apaton; their shaman is Mosagann; Mosagann has a daughter, @Sahree, who is Aiela's friend."
"The Nahuatla build their village of stone." "Moctapotl is their chief."

"The Disquiqui live west of the @Nahuatla. They do not do much work. They harvest fruits and ferment them into strong drink, and then consume it all." "Their chief is named Chafblum. He has a daughter named Guoblum." "You aren't kidding, doll! And keep Guoblum away from me!"
"$P knows well who Tristia is! Tristia has spread word far and wide that she is $P's mate. She crows it to the wind and stars. Why would $P choose someone like Tristia?" She seems almost in tears.

"There are many tribes in this valley. Aiela will tell $P of them." "There are the @Kurak, Aiela's tribe, jungle-dwellers. Near the Kurak are the dark-skinned @Yolaru, the @Nahuatla, who build their village of stone, and the @Disquiqui, who make merry all their lives." "There are many other, more distant tribes: The Pindiro and the Barako, the Jukari and the misshapen Haakur, the Barrab and the lizard-like Sakkhra, the ant-like @Myrmidex, and the @Urali, who had stolen Aiela away." She kisses you. "But there is only one who may steal Aiela away, and that is $P."

"Aiela has often wished that the tribes would unite against the @Myrmidex. Aiela and her friend @Sahree have discussed this much." "But the chiefs do not listen to their daughters in such matters." Then her eyes narrow as she looks at you. "$P has already won Aiela's heart. Aiela is sure that $P could win friendship from the chiefs. Aiela's father @Aloron will already help you." "Aiela thinks that $P could command respect of the chiefs and @unite all the tribes... if only he would try."
"Aiela is already $P's war-companion."
"Aiela will not be ordered! Aiela will stay here if she pleases."
"Aiela will not wait here for you. Aiela is not $P's @companion, in war or in anything."
"Aiela is already companion to $P. $P is sometimes forgetful." She grins.
She snorts and turns away.
She sighs. "Aiela knows nothing of this." "But she is willing for $P to tell her of it," she adds hopefully.

The hurt look disappears and is gradually replaced by a smile. "Aiela is glad. Aiela has long loved $P, since first she saw him. But when she heard that he preferred @Tristia..." She steps up and embraces you. "Be true of heart with Aeila, and Aiela will stay true of heart with $P." And she kisses you, her lips sweet as the perfume of a jungle flower.
Her expression turns to one of fury. "$P plays with Aiela's heart! $P is cruel and evil. Leave Aiela alone!"
"It is Dokray." (He pronounces it dough-CRAY.)
You see a glimmer of recognition in his eyes. "You speak of a name which is somehow familiar."
"Yes, name is Dokray."
"Dokray quests across all the Valley of @Eodon, fighting bad things like the @Myrmidex."
"Dokray's home is with the @Pindiro, but Dokray visits many other tribes."
He waves his hands as if to encompass all the world. "This land is all the Valley of Eodon. Dokray thought that Eodon was all the world until $P came from outside. So @Intanya says."

He snarls as he speaks. "Myrmidex are ant-like but are the height of men. They are fierce warriors." "It is not because they have any skill; they do not. But they are without fear and without pain." "They come into the human villages and kill the people, especially the weak and the young. Dokray hates the Myrmidex. But Dokray cannot make the tribes @unite against them."

"The tribes fight one another, even as the Myrmidex move among them and kill them. The tribes MUST unite to fight the Myrmidex. But Dokray cannot persuade them to unite. The @chiefs will not listen to Dokray."

"Dokray belongs to Pindiro tribe of the north. But..." He frowns. "Dokray was not born a Pindiro." "Dokray wandered out of the mountains many moons ago, with no memory of his past. The Pindiro adopted Dokray."
"The tribes cannot unite until the chiefs so decree. But when Dokray talks to the chiefs about it, they do not listen. Dokray is a great warrior... but cannot convince with words." He shrugs.
"A man has a name like that. Raf-Kin lives among the @Yolaru."
"The Yolaru are a good tribe. They live east of the Kurak village."
"Dokray knows of a man named Topuru. Topuru is mad. Topuru lives on a little island somewhere in the north, not far from Barako village."
"There are two tribes in the far north: The Pindiro of the plains, Dokray's tribe; and the Barako of the mountains."

"Intanya is shaman of the Kurak tribe. But Intanya is far more." "Intanya keeps his ear to the ground for all the valley, tries to keep wars between the tribes from becoming too fierce, tries to keep the @Myrmidex at bay."
"Triolo is helper-shaman of Intanya. Triolo sings to himself all the time." He gives a sly look over to Triolo. "Badly," he adds. "Triolo heard that!" Dokray grins.
"Dokray knows of three shamans. Did $P mean the Pindiro shaman @Kunawo, @Intanya or @Triolo?"
"Shamuru is a warrior of the Barako tribe. Very quiet. Good tracker, good hunter. Dokray is better warrior."
He shakes his head. "Dokray did not hear $P very well. Did $P say 'Shaman'?"
"Yes, let us stop talking. Dokray and $P should go find something to smash!"
"If $P wants Dokray to leave, $P has only to ask."
"No, Dokray has things to do. Dokray will not wait here."
He gives you a strange look. "Is this a foreign thing? Dokray is already with $P."
"Ask Triolo about that."
"Ah. Did $P mean @Intanya or @Triolo?"
"Ah. Then did $P say 'Shamuru'?"

4.name: Jimmy
4.look: a lanky, sharp-eyed man in his mid-20s.
4.hello: "Hey there, $P... about time you got around to showing up!" "Hey! $P! Go around inside and unlock this door, and let me out of here!" "Hey, it's your nickel. Talk to me." "You know, if you've given up on @Aiela, I'd sure like to go after her, myself."

qa.a: "Too much action muddle your brains, Mr. Adventurer? Jimmy Malone." He scribbles something in his @notebook.
He snaps his fingers impatiently. "That's my name, alright. Don't wear it out."
"I'm a reporter, see. For the local paper, and I also do pieces for ULTIMATE ADVENTURES @Magazine." "One of my first will be a 'Modern Man Among the Natives' piece about the @Disquiqui."
"Yeah, it's a nice camera, isn't it? Got a great deal, and it even came with a flash." He spends a short time showing you how to use it.
"Chafblum. King of the @Disquiqui tribe. One grumpy, evil-tempered son of a gun. Has a face like a washboard somebody's taken a hammer to."
"Oh, those Disquiqui natives. Feed you fermented coconut milk all the time." He shudders. "@Chafblum's the chief. @Guoblum's his daughter."
"She's the Disquiqui princess. Chafblum's daughter. Looks like a statue of Buddha. They want to marry me to her." He shivers.
"Myrmidex. Ant-creatures, big ones. The Disquiqui are scared to death of 'em. They're bad news."
"Yeah, Darden... that big guy with the huge lizard. He's the one who snagged @Aiela when we first got here." "Glad we managed to get her back with us again!"
"What a good-lookin' babe. Can't blame @Darden for making a move on her."
"ULTIMATE ADVENTURES Magazine. A true-adventure rag I do occasional articles for. I'll have to do a piece on this place. And on you, too. You'll have to tell me your life story sometime."
"Yeah, thrilling to talk to you, too."
"Leave? Hey, I was here first... YOU leave!"
"What does it look like I'm doing already? Sheesh."
"Hey, I'm already with you."
"My notebook? Nothing in it but some notes on this place. I'm going to write up a doozy of an article for ULTIMATE ADVENTURES Magazine when... IF... we get back."
"Thanks a lot. I'll be right here."
"Okay," he says dejectedly. "If you want me, you know where to find me. At Guoblum's wedding service." He looks like he's been hit by a truck.

5.name: Johann
5.look: a lean, dark-bearded man with kindly eyes.
5.hello: "Yes, $P?" "$P, I really need to talk to you about certain @problems we are facing.&

qa.a: "I am Dr. Johann Spector, of course. Though my sanity has returned, my name remains the same.&
"No, please, just call me Johann.&
He sighs. "I have no job. I WAS an archaeologist. I seem to have botched that. And I've certainly abandoned my former role as Zipactriotl, self-serving shaman of the Nahuatla.&
"I no longer have any association with any tribe here. I somehow doubt the Nahuatla would want me back.&

"Now that my mind is clear, I see that there are many problems which face us with the Myrmidex.& "These creatures are too great in number for any single band of men to defeat. I think we'll need to unite all the tribes in this land if we're to defeat the Myrmidex.& "But just defeating them isn't enough. We must destroy their queen... else she will simply spawn a new generation of warriors to kill us.& "And just destroying HER isn't enough. Somewhere in the Myrmidex caverns, there is an enormous black stone, like the small stones which transported us here.& "This stone is throwing off bizarre, incredible energies which warp the flow of time in this valley. It could very well be that we are all trapped here until it is destroyed.& "Even if we are not, and we find a way out, there's no telling what its presence could do. The Myrmidex might some day figure out how to tap its incredible power... which would be death to all humans here, and perhaps throughout the world.& "The @stone in the @Myrmidex caves MUST be destroyed.&

"The Myrmidex caves house an enormous black stone possessing strange energies. It was these energies that drove me mad. The stone is dangerous and must be destroyed.& "I think that the stone was originally set up in the Underground City of the Kotl. When the Kotl servants, the @Myrmidex, rebelled, they took the stone with them.& "But the @Kotl generators managed to continue drawing power from the stone.&

"According to all I was able to grasp in the Underground City of the @Kotl, the Kotl deliberately bred the Myrmidex as a race of super-servants.& "But the Myrmidex were too savage and escaped, carrying the black @stone with them.&

"The Kotl, who built the underground city, were a bipedal reptilian race descended from small, two-legged carnosaurs.& "They had great mystical knowledge and were able to draw mystic power from the giant black @stone. They ran their city with this power.& "They also used this power to breed themselves a race of servants, the Myrmidex. However, the Myrmidex became too savage to control, and escaped with the stone.& "Fortunately for the Kotl, the mystic generators continued drawing power from the stones, even over this great distance.& "It appears that the Kotl tried again, going out into the outer world and capturing representative human tribes from all over the world. Those tribesmen were the ancestors of the tribes living here today.& "But men are just as aggressive as ants, and they, too, escaped to freedom.& "It would seem that the Myrmidex returned to destroy their former masters, and drove the Kotl out of the Underground City, which sealed behind them.& "It remained sealed until I, with my understanding of the ways of the power from the black stones, was able to open the doors. I didn't leave them open, as you found out. But you got in anyway.& "The escaping Kotl appear to be the ancestors of today's Sakkhra.&
"Yes, we must unite the tribes. The tribes here follow the word of their chiefs, so we must go to each chief and persuade him to join this union.&
He shakes his head. "$P, I can never make up for what I've done if I drift around this valley. I want to accompany you and participate in fixing these problems. So I'm not going to leave you.&
"I'm already with you, $P.&
"Yes, yes. We'll talk later.&
"I don't grasp what you mean.&

6.name: Kysstaa
6.look: a handsome but fearsome-looking reptile man.
6.hello: "Sssss. What doesss huuman waant?& "Sssss. It isss $P. What does $P waant?&

qa.a: "Sssss. I am Kysstaa the Great.&
"Sssss. Kysstaa is warrior. Questor. Enemy of @Myrmidex.&
"Sssss. Kysstaa is of Sakkhra. Hide liike ssstone, teeth liike knives, ssso are the Sakkhra.&

"Sssss. Ant-thiings. Eeevil. Kysstaa bites them uuntil they ssstop moving. Myrmidex aare death to huumans and Sakkhra. Kysstaa is death to Myrmidex.& "If $P wantsss to go bite Myrmidex, Kysstaa will @join him and help.&
"Sssss. Iss blue ssstone in cavess of Sakkhra.&
"Sssss. Do not oorder Kysstaa. Kysstaa ssstays or leavess as he pleasses.&
"Sssss. Do not oorder Kysstaa. Kysstaa ssstays or leavess as he pleasses.&
"Sssss. Kysstaa is aalready wiith $P. Brotherss-in-fangs, one huuman, one Sakkhra.&
"Sssss.& He turns his mind to other things.
"Sssss. Not taalk of thisss.&

7.name: Rafkin
7.look: a stooped, fiftyish man who looks like a professor.
7.hello: "$P! It's good to see you again! I had heard you were still alive, but I didn't know where you were." "I see you haven't managed to find @Jimmy or @Aiela yet... that really should be one of our first priorities, you know." "I see you have found Mr. Malone already. That's good. We should try to find @Aiela next." "Now that you're here, it might be helpful to find the lab. There are several things there which will be very useful to us. It must be fairly close to the Kurak village." "While I've been waiting for you to show up, I haven't been wasting my time here. In addition to my researches on t

qa.a: "Eh? Eh? MY name? You've known my name for years. Professor Elliot Archimedes Rafkin, Ph.D., etc."
"Yes, $P, what is it?"

"Principally, I'm the curator of the local museum of natural history." "Most recently, I've been the chief doctor and man of science in the village of the @Yolaru. I have spent much of my time studying the @tribes of this @valley."
Professor Rafkin nods. "Yes, this is my laboratory.

"She had been captured by that ponderous fellow from the @Urali tribe. Fortunately you managed to free her." "I understand she was captured by the @Urali tribe. She seemed like a tough individual, but I hope she is all right. I hope we go and search for her soon."

"You know nearly as much about the Urali as I do, $P. After all, you rescued Aiela from them. I never did get much chance to study their culture." "From what I can make out, the Urali were thought to have disappeared for many years. They have only recently started raiding other villages, which leads me to suspect their village must be well-hidden." "Local hunters have confirmed this supposition, saying that they have been trying to find them for some time. The raids seem to come from southeast of the Yolaru village, usually."
"This whole area in which we find ourselves is called the Valley of Eodon."
Prof. Rafkin points at Jimmy distractedly. "He's over there, $P."

"There are many tribes here, my boy. Let us see, in alphabetical order: Barako, Barrab, @Disquiqui, @Haakur, Jukari, @Kurak, @Nahuatla, Pindiro, @Sakkhra, @Urali, and @Yolaru." "From my studies of the tribesmen I've met, I believe that they were brought here from all over the world in ancient times." "Their individual languages have obviously melded into one tongue, that which they all speak today."
"I haven't had time to do much research on that tribe yet."
"The Disquiqui are an interesting tribe. They seem to have broken away from the conflict-oriented tradition of many of the other groups." "Their village lies west of the Nahuatla city."
"The Nahuatla men in this valley seem to be descended from the same race which developed into the Aztecs of central America." "Their city, Tichticatl, is due south of the Yolaru village."
"The Haakur! Living examples of Neanderthal man, my boy! How I wish I could take one back with me to the museum."
"I suspect that the Kurak are descended from the first early pioneers who crossed the land bridge from Asia to North America... but it would take years of study to bear out this theory."
His eyes light up. "The Sakkhra! I have seen them. A race that exists nowhere in the fossil record, my boy! A bipedal reptilian race with an intelligence on a par with that of the human race!"
"A delightful tribe! Very civilized. I have lived among them since we came to the valley. Culturally, they have certain similarities to the ancient Kushites."
"Ah. Are you saying you want me to manufacture you a rifle? Just like that?"
"$P, are you asking me to build you a grenade?"
He makes a series of 'tsk,tsk' noises. "You want instructions on making gunpowder?"
He makes a series of 'tsk,tsk' noises. "You want instructions on making gunpowder?"
"Using tarred cloth strips on a branch would make an excellent torch."
"The best way to get charcoal would be to burn a @branch with a campfire or firepit."
"I'm sure you can pull branches from almost any tree."
"Potassium nitrate. Also called saltpeter. There was a bottle of it back at my @laboratory." "Chances are good that most caves will have crystalline deposits, as well."
"You will need a hard clay pot to make grenades. That's simple to accomplish." "If you can't find a hard clay pot, find a soft one and place it in a @kiln for a while."
"A large oven used for baking soft clay pots."
"You'll probably find sulphur pits in the vicinity of volcanoes. You'll need a wire @screen of some kind to extract usable sulpher."
"It would have to be fairly tough wire screen. I think there was some back at the @lab that would work."
"A mortar. You know, a bowl used for grinding raw materials down into powder. NOT something for lobbing shells at the enemy." "I had one back at the @lab."
"A grinding stone, or grindstone. You can find them by the dozens in native villages."
He scowls. "I most certainly will NOT leave. I was here first. Who do you think you are, ordering me about? Hmph."
"Yes, a strip of cloth. You'll probably need a knife or scissors to cut one from a sheet of cloth."
"Any tar found in this land will undoubtedly be extremely hot. I would reccomend collecting it in a metal container of some kind. A bucket, perhaps."
"Ask the Nahuatla tribesman where to find some."
"You're welcome."
"I most certainly will NOT wait here. I'm a busy man. Things to do. Wait, indeed."
"Join what? Is something in need of repair?" He blinks owlishly. "Oh, you mean join YOU. I'm already with you."

Rafkin looks sheepish. "Er, yes. That's what the Yolaru call me. They offered to make me their shaman. I said that I'd be their Schweitzer instead." "I was referring to Albert Schweitzer. He was a missionary in Africa. Doctor, writer, musician. A remarkable man." "But the Yolaru took it as my title. 'Schweitzer: A special sort of shaman.' I didn't correct their misapprehension." He smiles crookedly. "Oops."
"That's right, plumb my brains and then ignore me. abandon me for more interesting pursuits. Humpf."
"Ask me about that later."
"Oh, very well. Let's see if you've brought me the proper parts."
"Well, good. I was busy thinking."

8.name: Shamuru
8.look: a quiet man, almost more a jungle spirit than a man.
8.hello: "Yes, friend $P?" "It is $P! It has been long since Shamuru has seen you awake... long since the night that Darden the Huge trampled through our camp."

qa.a: "Shamuru is the name the Barako @gave me."

"Shamuru is a tracker, a hunter, the best in all the valley." "Shamuru enjoys traveling Eodon with $P." "Shamuru also enjoys going to new places and exploring new things. If $P would like for Shamuru to @join with him, he has but to ask."
"Shamuru is an @adopted warrior of the Barako tribe. The Barakos live on the ledges to the north."

"Yes. Shamuru was not born to the Barakos. Indeed, Shamuru is more at home in the jungle than in the mountains where the Barakos live." "Shamuru was found many moons ago wandering, naked and unarmed, his mind as clean as a baby's, in the high mountains above the Barako village." "The Barakos took Shamuru in and made him a brother warrior. Shamuru does not remember his life before that time."
"I've never seen an Ankylosaur, I never hope to see one But this I will say anyhow - I'd rather see than be one."
"Your words..." He frowns. "Shamuru seems to see far-away things, places, people. Shamuru does not understand."
"You presume much, telling Shamuru to leave."
"You presume much, telling Shamuru to wait."
He gives you a slight smile. "Shamuru is with $P already."
"A pleasure."
"Ask Dokray about that."

9.name: Triolo
9.look: a sprightly grey-bearded man with an alert eye.
9.hello: He looks at you intently for several moments before speaking, as if trying to place your face. "Triolo has heard of $P. $P's face is very familiar, somehow." "Does $P need help with something?"

qa.a: "Triolo is the name given me by the @Kuraks."
"Triolo is a shaman-in-training. The great shaman @Intanya is Triolo's teacher." "Triolo's newest task is to follow $P around... and convey to him the will of the @spirits."

"Triolo belongs to the Kurak tribe. Triolo was not born a Kurak: Triolo came stumbling from the jungle, bereft of name and memory, many moons ago. Since then, @Intanya has taught Triolo the ways of the shaman."
"Triolo has learned only a small part of what Intanya knows. Small magics, but useful."
"Intanya, a great man, is shaman of the Kuraks. Triolo learns the spirit-magic of the shamans from him."
Triolo gestures towards Shamuru. "Shamuru is there." "Shamuru is a hunter and tracker, of the @Barako tribe."
He looks puzzled. "Did $P mean shaman or shamuru?"
"Yopo is a mostly green plant used in many incantations."
"Pinde makes strong magics."
"Brown beans, very strong taste. Use it in spells."
"Used to invoke the spirits."
"That is the spirit of emotions, and strength."
"Motazz is the spirit of battle."
"That is the spirit of knowledge and visions."
Triolo gestures towards Aiela. "She is Aiela."
"Barako village is close to the Kurak, but across the deep canyon of waters."
"Yes, Triolo sings. How did $P know that?"
He frowns. "$P's names call up images to Triolo's mind. Distant lands, faces with forgotten names. Perhaps $P is invoking a spirit of memory."
"The tribes war on one another while a terrible enemy, the @Myrmidex, kill them one by one. Intanya does all he can, but he cannot persuade the chiefs to unite."
"Myrmidex are like ants... but are the size of men. They are fierce meat-eaters."
"Leave? No, Triolo thinks he will stay here, and perhaps compose a tune."
"Triolo waits for no man! Perhaps if a woman were to ask... A she-cat with a dimple in her smile... Triolo would wait for that."
His eyes twinkle. He looks at you, behind you, behind him, under his arm. Finally, he looks down at himself and yelps. "$P! Triolo is already here."
"$P should ask another about that."
"Very well, speak to Triolo later."
"Ask Shamuru about that." "$P should ask another about that."
"You need an orchid root for Nakai. Here."
"You need a small blue stone for Topuru. Here."
"You need a hammer to get the small blue stone. Here."
"You need turtle bait to cross the Urali swamp. Here."
"I don't know how to help you."

10.name: Ugyuk
10.hello: Dokray leans over and whispers into your ear: "Ugyuk is strongest and dumbest of all Haakur. Dokray and Ugyuk have fought many times. Dokray always wins, of course." The Neanderthal sniffs the air. The Neanderthal speaks in a deep, growling voice. "Smell new smell. Smell Dokray. Dokray bad. Dokray go away." The Neanderthal waves Dokray away, glowering at him, but does not go for his weapons. The Neanderthal speaks in a grunting, gravelly voice: "Not know smell. New. Not like others. What want new smell?" "Ugyuk smell $P." "Bad Dokray is with $P. Does Ugyuk talk or smash?" His brow furrows. "Hu

qa.a: "Ugyuk is name. Name is Ugyuk." He seems rather proud of the concept.
"Ugyuk. UG-YUK."

"Ugyuk strong. Smash skulls of lizards, enemies like @Dokray. Eat hearts. Become strongest." He demonstrates, pretending to smash his club into the skull of an imaginary beast. He pounds... ... and pounds ... ... and pounds.

"Ugyuk of Haakur tribe. Not know other tribes. Too many words. Too many names. New smell -- " he points at you -- "not from other tribes. Not from @Jukari. Jukari enemies." "Haakur live where hills spit fire." He spits on your foot to demonstrate, and points at it. "But fire." "Haakur chief @Grugorr. Grugorr."

"Dokray bad. Small, stupid. Always attack Ugyuk. Ugyuk always smash Dokray's brains." He waves his hands to mime his club coming down and someone's brains flying in all directions. Dokray speaks up: "Ugyuk lies! Dokray always smashes Ugyuk. $P, let Dokray smash Ugyuk NOW."
"Ugyuk not know. Words like what chief say. Chief @Grugorr."
"Grugorr chief Haakur."

"Bug bug bug! " "No my dear boy, those aren't bugs. They are simply another feature of this valley, which I'm documenting thoroughly." Ugyuk stares blankly at the professor for a moment, then resumes "Big bug-things. Bad. More bad than @Dokray." Big bug-things. Bad. More bad than @Dokray."
"No, Ugyuk stay. This is place of Ugyuk."
"Ugyuk wait here. Or go other place."
He has to think about that for a while. He thinks about it for a while longer. Finally: "Ugyuk did that already."
"Jukari! Men. Live near Haakur. Have many @sparklies."

"Sparklies. Sparklies!" He gestures, pretending to hold something small up to his ears, nose, neck... "Sparkly rocks." Prof. Rafkin speaks up: "I think, my boy, that he's referring to diamonds. Diamond jewelry." Ugyuk nods vehemently. "Yes. What he say."
The Neanderthal shrugs and turns away.
"Ugyuk not know. Is good to eat?"
"Bad Dokray! Bad Dokray! Ugyuk will smash all!"

Dokray's face falls. He turns back to Ugyuk. "Later," he suggests, "when new friends are not here, Dokray will smash Ugyuk's face into new shape." Ugyuk snarls. "Bring whole tribe," he suggests, then turns back to you.

11.name: Yunapotli
11.look: a golden statue made in the shape of a human.
11.hello: The statue says nothing. (Neither would you, with your head missing!) "Greet-ings. Wel-come to the @Ci-ty of the Kot-l." "The ci-ty is ac-tive. I see the @gen-er-a-tors are func-tion-ing." The automoton looks at the silver figure seated next to him. "How-ev-er, I see that some of the guar-di-an ser-vants have bro-ken down." Jimmy breaks in: "So that's a guard? Sorta like an Argent Sergeant, eh?" "I see you are a hu-man. In the ab-sence of con-tra-dic-to-ry or-ders from my mas-ters, I will join your par-ty and serve you. How may I ac-com-mo-date you?" "How may I serve you?"

qa.a: "I am Yu-na-pot-li. I know it is my name for I re-mem-ber it." The automaton pauses for a moment, as if thinking. "I would re-mem-ber much more, if I had my @brain."

"My oc-cu-pa-tion is that of ser-vant. E-ver since the hu-mans left, I and @o-thers like me have served the @Kot-l." "E-ver since the Kot-l @left, I have been the guar-di-an of the doors to the ci-ty. It is my job to @swing the doors o-pen and closed."
"Ma-ny of my me-mo-ries were im-bued in the crys-tal brain which you re-turned to me."

"It was the Kot-l who cre-a-ted me. They were wise be-ings. They were not hu-mans. They were rep-tiles." "They once had hu-mans as ser-vants. That is why I am shaped as a hu-man, for I am a ser-vant. But the Kot-l are gone now; they @left." "@Kat-al-kot-l knows ma-ny things about the Kot-l. You should speak with him."
"There are o-ther au-to-ma-tons like my-self with-in the Ci-ty of the Kot-l. They are not so in-tel-li-gent as I. I have no i-dea what they have been do-ing since the Kot-l left and I fell a-sleep."
"The doors to the city are al-rea-dy o-pen!"

"Yes, the Kot-l left a long long time a-go. The @Myr-mi-dex at-tacked them. I do not re-mem-ber why. Per-haps you should ask @Kat-al-kot-l." "When they left, they placed me at the doors. I was to ad-mit a-ny Kot-l or a-ny-one with peace-ful in-tent. They left the @gen-er-a-tors run-ning so that the ci-ty would be pleas-ant." "But much la-ter some men came and took my head so I could not think. It has ob-vi-ous-ly been re-att-ached." "The last thing I re-mem-ber is one of the hu-mans reach-ing for my head."
"The Myr-mi-dex are gi-ant in-sects. They are sa-vage and re-pel-lant. I do not re-mem-ber much a-bout them. Per-haps you should ask @Kat-al-kot-l."

"This is the Ci-ty of the Kot-l, built long long a-go be-fore hu-mans came or Myr-mi-dex came. Now I think no one lives here." "The Ci-ty of the Kot-l was built long a-go be-fore hu-mans came or Myr-mi-dex came. Now I think no one lives there."
"Kat-al-kot-l is ve-ry wise. He stands in the cen-ter of the Great Pla-za of the Ci-ty. He an-swers many quest-ions." "But he can-not move and can-not touch a-ny-thing."
"Hu-mans. Hu-mans were once the ser-vants of the Kot-l, I think. You should ask @Kat-al-kot-l."
"The ci-ty is pow-wered by migh-ty gen-er-a-tors." "You should ask @Kat-al-kot-l a-bout them. He would know more than I." "But you can-not see them now for the doors to the ci-ty are closed."

"The Kot-l cre-at-ed man-y in-ter-est-ing de-vices. When the @Myr-mi-dex at-tacked, they al-so cre-at-ed @weap-ons and @arm-or to help de-fend the ci-ty." "One you may find in-ter-est-ing is a de-vice to help @lo-cate the black stone the Myrm-i-dex took." "Most de-vic-es should still func-tion. You may use an-y you find."
"It is a round ob-ject with a light which in-di-cates a path towards the black stone."

"You may find a long black staff. It caus-es great dam-age a-gainst the Myr-mi-dex." "They also found a gas that was ve-ry eff-ect-ive a-gainst the Myr-mi-dex. It is found in large green can-is-ters."
"Kot-l ar-mor would not fit you. But they cre-at-ed a ve-ry good shi-eld that you could use."
"I know the Kot-l cre-at-ed heal-ing crys-tals that could al-so heal hu-mans."
"But I can-not. I have o-pened the doors to the ci-ty. Now it is my du-ty to be your guide." It is my du-ty to stay with you and open the @doors to the ci-ty."
"I am al-rea-dy with you, sir."
"De-light-ed to speak with you. I hope we will talk a-gain soon."
"Ve-ry well, I shall not."

16.name: Aloron
16.look: an aging but still-mighty warrior with wise eyes.
16.hello: "So. It is $P. Long he lay in the village of the Kuraks, smashed when @Darden took @Aiela away.& "Now he comes before the chief of the Kuraks, and has rescued Aiela, daughter of the chief. The chief is pleased to welcome his friend $P.& "Now he has regained his strength, and comes before the chief of the Kuraks. What does he want?& "Ah, it is $P, rescuer of Aiela! You are a welcome guest here. What may Aloron help $P with?& "Why does $P come before Aloron again when he has not rescued Aiela? What does he want?& "$P is welcome in the village of the Kuraks.&

qa.a: "$P speaks to Aloron, father of @Aiela.& Aiela runs over to embrace her father briefly. "$P has come home with me to visit my father.&

"This warrior is chief of the Kurak tribe. He leads the Kurak warriors against the @Myrmidex and the @Yolaru.& Prof. Rafkin whispers in your ear: "Among the @Yolaru, with whom I lived, Aloron was well-known and respected. He's supposed to be an honest and forthright chieftain.&

"There are many tribes in this valley. We are the Kuraks. There are also the @Yolaru, the Disquiqu, and the Nahuatla in their stone village.& "Further away, there are Pindiro and Barako in the far north, Jukari and ugly Haakur in the southeast, Barrab and lizard-Sakkhra in southwest.& "Hidden away somewhere southeast are the @Urali.&
The chieftain smiles. "Aloron is grateful to $P for rescuing his daughter Aiela.&

"If $P wants bones, he should go east of the Kurak village until he reaches the @Yolaru village. From there, he must go south, keeping the cliff ever to his left.& "Soon, he will find the place where the big lizards go to die.&
"If $P wants bamboo, he must travel south of the place of many @bones. There he will find a stand of bamboo.&

"The Yolaru are a tribe to the east of the Kuraks. Their chief is Apaton.& Aloron scowls at his daughter. "Aiela is friends with them, with the shaman's daughter Sahree. Aiela is a disobedient child sometimes.& Aiela speaks up, indignant: "Aiela sometimes knows better than her father what is good for the Kuraks.& "While Kuraks war with Yolaru, while all tribes war with all others, the @Myrmidex will always be able to defeat all the tribes.& "Aiela and her friend Sahree know that the tribes must @unite against the Myrmidex... even if their fathers do not know this yet.& The chief merely snorts.

"Myrmidex. Giant warrior-insects. They live very close, to the west of the Kurak village. They raid here all the time, killing and eating.& "The Kurak are the greatest warriors in all the valley. But the Myrmidex are... other than human.& "Mighty beyond belief, in their numbers and ferocity. The Kuraks fall before them.& Aiela breaks in: "My father, Aiela is certain that the Kuraks would defeat the Myrmidex if only we would @unite with the @Yolaru and other tribes...& The chief frowns. "The @Yolaru are enemies of the Kurak. Enemies, always. Not worth befriending.&
"Topuru was the shaman of the @Urali long ago. Topuru went mad; Aloron does not know why. Somewhere in the far, far north, Topuru lives on a little island.&
"Aloron no longer needs to visit vengeance upon the Urali. Aloron has his daughter back.&
"The @Urali were a peaceful tribe until Darden the Huge became chief. Only then did they begin to raid others.&
"Does $P speak of uniting all the tribes of the valley?&
"$P is in the village of the Kurak tribe.&

"$P speaks of the Great Drum of legend. In ancient past, the warrior Oloro-of-No-Tribe built a great drum on a hill near the stone village of the Nahuatla.& "If $P wants to @unite the tribes, he should build new Great Drum there.&
"$P may always speak to Aloron. $P rescued Aiela from savage Urali men.&
"Then Aloron does not know of what $P speaks.&

17.name: Apaton
17.look: a lean, sharp-eyed, dignified black warrior.
17.hello: He says nothing, but looks at you expectantly, waiting for you to begin speaking. His face breaks into a smile. "Ah. $P addresses the chief of the Yolaru. $P is most welcome. Come, speak to Apaton.& He looks at you coldly for a moment. "It is $P, who tries to cheat Apaton by offering too few weapons. What does $P want now?& He nods at you, a cool greeting, and waits.

qa.a: "Apaton.& He indicates himself.

"Chief of @Yolaru tribe.& "As @schweitzer knows.& He points at Prof. Rafkin. "Good day, great Apaton. Be nice to my friend $P, for he's a very good man, even if he's sloppy, forgetful, thoughtless, and a poor student.& The chieftain blinks impassively and turns back to you.
"Yolaru tribe. We say little, do much. We fight the @Myrmidex and the @Kuraks.&
"Kurak tribe. Live west of Yolaru. Good fighters. Kuraks have better weapons than Yolaru. Yolaru are better fighters.&
"South of village, past @bones.&
"@Barrab tribe has blue stone.&
"Far southwest, land of mesas.&
"South of village, near cliffs.&
"Kill beast, use knife on carcass.&
"King of Nahuatla.&
"Fierce ants grown huge. Enemy of all.& "Apaton has promised to help destroy Myrmidex. $P brought weapons for Yolaru.&

Prof. Rafkin nudges you. "The chief well knows who I am, my boy.& He turns to the chief. "By the way, your greatness, I will be travelling with $P for awhile.& "No. Schweitzer must stay in village.& "Perhaps you would prefer it if I turned you and all your warriors into tree-toads?& "Schweitzer is ordered to travel with $P.&
"Mad @Urali. No friend of Urali tribe, or any other. Lives in far north somewhere, on island.&
"Raiders. Come from southeast. Apaton does not know where.& He thinks a moment. "@Topuru would know where Urali live.&
"@Urali did not raid other tribes until Darden the Huge became their chief.&
He gestures around him. "@Yolaru tribe.&
"Speak of uniting tribes? Making allies of enemies?& "$P has already made allies of Yolaru. $P must go to other tribes to make allies of them.&
"$P may return whenever $P wishes.& He turns away from you.
"Apaton does not understand.&
"Do not speak of making allies of Yolaru until ten Nahuatla swords are brought to Yolaru. Apaton has spoken of this already: Yolaru need weapons to fight lizards and Myrmidex.&
He thinks about it. "Good enough reason to stop noble wars?& He shrugs. "Apaton might consider this... but only to benefit whole tribe.&
He frowns. "'Because' is reason for children, and to give to children. Apaton asks again: Why?&

18.name: Atlipacta
18.look: a sharp-faced but beautiful woman in Aztec dress.
18.hello: "Blessings of the spirits on you!" "You have returned. Perhaps you will choose to @trade for some of my weapons."

qa.a: "I am Atlipacta."
"I am a crafter of weapons and armor." "Perhaps you would care to @trade for some of my crafts."
"This is Tichticatl, the city of the Nahuatla."
"Yes, I have many fine weapons to @trade."
"I @trade both leather shields and armor."
"Emeralds are valuable to me. I will trade both weapons and shields for them."
"Yes, I used to @trade for blue stones from the southwest. Now I only need @emeralds."
"I do not trade for $Z."
"I have heard of a drum-maker named Tuomaxx. He lives on a hill north of Tichticatl somewhere."
"Our king is Moctapotl. He was until recently in exile, but his usurper, Huitlapacti, has been cast down. Nor will I miss Huitlapacti."
"I have never seen the Myrmidex. I know they are fierce. I know I would wish to be wearing my own armor when facing them."
Her voice is sharp: "Don't speak his name to me! That vile madman had my own @brother killed."

"Yes, my brother was one of Huitlapacti's guards. One day, Huitlapacti hadn't had his fill of killing, and had no more victims..." "So he had his guards draw lots to see who would die next. It was my brother."
"Yes, I @trade in that."
"May the spirits guide you on your path. Do return when you are in need of a well-made weapon!"
"I do not know what you are saying."
"I'll take two emeralds for a bow. How many would you like?"
"I'll trade you a dozen arrows for one emerald. How many dozens would you like?"
"I'll give you one knife for one emerald. How many would you like?"
"I'll trade you one sword for three emeralds. How many would you like?"
"I'll take three emeralds for one set of leather armor. How many would you like?"
"I'll take one emerald for a shield. How many would you like?"

19.name: Balakai
19.look: a somber man wearing shamanistic face-paints.
19.hello: "This one is tending a very @sick boy, and humbly begs that all visitors remain soft of voice." "Balakai welcomes noble $P, hero of the Barrab, savior of young Nakai." "This one sees that someone here is hurt." "This one sees that someone here is hurt." He springs up eagerly: "Has the noble visitor $P brought medicine for Nakai?" "Balakai welcomes his most noble guest $P."

qa.a: "This one is addressed by the name Balakai."
"This one is chief to the Barrab tribe, and also shaman."
"Balakai has heard of one named Shamuru, but does not know him."
"What do you mean by '$Z'?"

"Balakai belongs to the Barrab tribe." "Nearby, to the west, are the @Sakkhra; they are not men, but reptiles shaped as warriors." "Far to the east are the Disquiqui; the Barrab trade with them. Balakai once fought a duel with one of them, called @Tuomaxx the Drum-Maker." "Much further east, there is a tribe called Urali. Balakai has only met one of them, a shaman called @Topuru." "Somewhere far away are the @Myrmidex."
"You are among the Barrab, dwellers on the mesa."
"Yes, Barrab dwell on mesa. To north are two other mesas. One is too small to live on, and we cannot reach the @Great Mesa."
"Nakai is no longer sick, thanks to $P."
"Nakola is very shy. She is probably hiding while strange $P is here."
"The visitor wishes to hear the story of the blue stone?"
"Sakkhra live to the west, in the caves where this one used to find his @blue stones. Their king is called @Sysskarr."
"Is there a need for healing?"
"Is there a need for healing?"
"Does the noble visitor wish to hear the story of Topuru?" He seems amused.
"Balakai does not understand the words of his visitor."

"Balakai knows of a drum-maker called Tuomaxx. A member of the Disquiqui tribe." "One of the Barrab warriors had sent many warriors of the Disquiqui into flight, and Tuomaxx came for revenge." "This one," he indicates himself, "confronted Tuomaxx and duelled him." "Though Balakai received many poking fingers from Tuomaxx, he convinced Tuomaxx that he had removed Tuomaxx' mind and placed it in a @blue stone. And Tuomaxx believed." "Tuomaxx was so delighted to be free of human intelligence that Tuomaxx thanked Balakai and left."
"It is the roots of the large pale flower that act as medicine. Chop it down, and bring the roots back to Balakai, and I may make Nakai well again."
"Balakai has seen them in his dreams. Balakai fears the Myrmidex. They are so fierce, and all fight as one." "Balakai has had many @dreams about the Myrmidex."
"In his dreams, Balakai has seen a warrior from some distant tribe. The warrior comes and @unites the tribes against the Myrmidex."
"Does the noble visitor speak of uniting the tribes?"

"The Sakkhra king is called Sysskarr. A mighty fighter." "When Balakai was but a stripling youth, and Sysskarr was a cunning, experienced warrior, they fought. They fought all day and all night." "Balakai was fortunate enough to defeat Sysskarr. He thought Sysskarr must have died from grievous wounds, but Sysskarr survived and leads the Sakkhra still."
"There is always hospitality here for noble visitors."
"Balakai does not understand the words of his visitor."
"The tribes might not wish to be united."
"Doubtless the noble visitor has other ambitions."
"How fortunate."

20.name: Chafblum
20.look: a short, scowling, black-haired, drunken native man.
20.hello: "Oh, YOU again." "Oh... a wise man, eh?" "All the time I was locked up by these Disquiqui, I had the weird feeling I'd seen this guy somewhere before..."

qa.a: He whacks you with a wooden spoon. "Chafblum did not tell you to speak. Now Chafblum will never tell you his name." He thinks about that for a moment, tries to figure out what went wrong, and scowls.
He scowls at you, and gestures for you to continue.

"Chafblum is father of @Guoblum. And Chafblum is a lizard-wrestler. Two jobs, very much same." "No, he is not! Chafblum is chief of Disquiqui tribe!" "Shaddup. Chafblum did not ask you." He whacks the native with his wooden spoon. "Chafblum is modest lizard-wrestler." "Daddy Chafblum is greatest chief in all the valley." His scowl grows deeper. "Chafblum has never seen that woman before in his life."
"Chafblum knows nothing of tribes. Especially this one."
"Who? Oh, right, Moctasomething, the Nahuatla guy. Glad he left - he was no fun." He's here somewhere... always sitting around moaning about being exiled."
"Chafblum makes great Pulque. Guoblum drinks it all. Guoblum is a greedy lizard."
"Your words call up strange memories, as if Chafblum once lived far away, under different name..." He blinks, then whacks you with his wooden spoon. "Stop that. It is distracting."
"Paddle? There is a paddle here, somewhere..." He looks around, but appears to be having trouble focusing very far, and quickly gives up. "You want paddle, go find one yourself!"

"Guoblum is daughter of Chafblum. Smile at the strangers, Guoblum." "Yoo hoo! Jimmy Malone! Come sit next to best girl, Guoblum!" "Yoo hoo! Guoblum! Go swimming in river full of piranhas! Take flying leap at rolling dinosaur!" "Oh, @Jimmy is no fun."

"Why, there is Jimmy Malone!" He points at Jimmy. "How did Jimmy get out of hut?" "Why, don't you remember, Chafblum-old-pal? You got drunk and decided that $P here would be a much better husband for Guoblum, and you let me out." "Did Chafblum do that? Must have; Jimmy Malone is free." He turns to you. "Ready for wedding?" "Wait! Jimmy Malone is big liar! Let $P find his own woman. Guoblum is for Jimmy Malone." "Sorry, stranger. Guoblum's mind is set. Find own woman."
"Disquiqui shaman is called Larrifin." He shouts: "Larrifin! Where is Larrifin?" "He's not here! "Too bad. Larrifin is not here."

"You want drums? Go to Tuomaxx. Best drum-maker in all Disquiqui village." "Chafblum banished him, remember?" "Shaddup! Who asked you?" "Yes, Chafblum banished Tuomaxx. Long story. Want to hear long story?"
"$P did well. Can hear Sharptooth in plenty of time to run away." "Will join $P's union of tribes, when the time comes."

"Sharptooth is big lizard. Bigger lizard even than Larrifin over there." "Larrifin heard that!" "Sharptooth lives southeast of village most of the time. Eats Disquiqui warriors and sleeps it off rest of the time."
"Want more plachta?"
"Too bad! Get your own."
"Then why you ask?" He whacks you with his jug of plachta.
"Ahhh, riddance is good."
"Chafblum doesn't know anything about $Z."
"Good choice."

21.name: Chizzztl
21.look: a Myrmidex soldier, bigger and glossier than the rest.
21.hello: Its mandibles writhe and clack as it forces itself to speak something like the human tongue. "Not allowed here. Must die. Will ask Queen." It cocks its head for about half a second. Then: "Queen agrees. Hive alerted. Meat-beings must die!" "Talking again? Why still alive?" It waits a moment. "Queen confirms. Meat-beings must be chewed!"

22.name: Cleese
22.look: a large, raucous, especially colorful parrot.
22.hello: "Ja, ja, ve haff vays of making you talk." "Who's the pretty boy? Who's the pretty boy?"

qa.a: "Cleese, do shut up! You're driving me @mad! SQUAWK! Driving me @mad!"
"Eat the @cracker, Cleese! Eat the cracker, Cleese! SQUAWK!" "It seems the only job you're capable of doing, @Fritz, is feeding your damned parrot."
"@SQUIRK!"
"@Chirrup!"
"@SKREE!"
"SQUAWK! @Chiurrrr SQUAWK!"
"@AWK!"
"@SQUAWK!"
"Ja, herr doktor. Ze Underground City of ze @Kotl sounds most impressive. SQUAWK!" "But your plans: Zey are... not entirely rational. Zey sound almost... @insane. SQUAWK!"
"Eat the cracker, Cleese!"

The parrot speaks in a different voice: "We cannot easily say zuh-peck-tor. It is alien to our tongues. SQUAWK!" "While you remain among the Nahuatla, you will be known as Zipactriotl. SQUAWK! Who's the pretty boy?"

"I tell you, Fritz, the lost civilization of these Kotl may have been the most magnificent ever known!" "Where's the cracker? Cleese, shut up!" "Their city is AWK! amazing. What calamity could have destroyed them?"

"Mad he calls me, mad!" "Fritz, there's no room in my @plans, in my world of the future, for a doubter such as yourself!" "SQUAWK! I'll never allow you to see my @city! Get out! Let the dinosaurs chew your bones!" "Good Lord, $P! That's Johann @Spector's voice!"
"Conquer the Earth, Conquer the Earth!" "Cleese, stop repeating SQUAWK! everything I say or it'll be parrot soup for lunch!"
The parrot stares at you expectantly.
The parrot looks at you disbelievingly. "With a @jaguar?"
"Well, they are kind of nice..."
"Spam spam spam. SQUAWK! Humbug."
"Hold the anchovies!"
"@Fizz!"
"@Plop!"
"I like the black ones... especially when they're puppies."
"Ja, ja, shut up! Just shut up!"
"Cleese, if you're going to squawk, squawk in English!"

23.name: Darden
23.look: a muscular, enormous, muscular, unkempt, muscular man.
23.hello: "You! Darden trampled you into the earth once before. Now Darden will be sure you will stay there!" "It is the $P! You have cost Darden much. Darden is not chief of Urali. You did this! You must die!" "It is the $P again! Has Darden not chased you before him? Why do you return? Only to die!"

24.name: Denys
24.look: a lean, thoughtful-looking, pale-skinned native man.
24.hello: "It seems there is a visitor. Visitor or invader? We will find out. What does the stranger want?" From his belt-pouch, he pulls a piece of charcoal and a scrap of hide from which all hair has been scraped. He frowns slightly, looking at Aiela, and begins sketching her, you, and begins sketching you, his hand moving in bold, deft strokes of the charcoal. "Once again Denys sees his most colorful visitor."

qa.a: "Denys. Some say, 'Denys the Enlightened'; others," he looks disappointed, "say 'Denys the Weak.'" "And how does Denys's visitor call himself?"
"Denys is a painter. Denys sees pictures in his mind and puts them on the walls of caves, on pieces of hide, on leaves, on whatever is at hand." He continues sketching as he talks to you.

"Denys is a member of the @hidden Urali tribe... though he is an @outcast now." "Denys knows that the beauteous Aiela has had unwanted attentions from Darden of the Urali tribe. This is no doing of Denys's." "Aiela bears no ill-will toward Denys, then."

"Not long ago, when Darden came to power, Darden took and hid the statue of the Great Fabozz, a spirit sacred to the Urali." "Darden told Denys to draw upon the cliff a mighty painting, one which would show @Fabozz going with Darden of his own will." "Denys refused, and then Denys had to run for Denys's life, for Darden was not happy."
"The Urali stay hidden from all the other tribes of the Valley of @Eodon. Is Denys's visitor asking because he wishes to learn where the Urali live?"
"The Great Fabozz is a mighty spirit of this land."
"This whole land, all the world, is called the Valley of Eodon."
"Fare well, colorful visitor."
"Denys does not know about that."
Denys's face becomes a little more guarded. "Denys is sorry, but even outcast, he is still of the Urali. Denys will not say where the Urali live."
"Denys's heart is made happy to hear it."

25.name: Fabozz
25.look: a giant stone head with luminescent green stone eyes.
25.hello: As the bright flash from your light floods the cave, there is a second, brighter flash. And when it fades... Fabozz is gone! A deep, sepulchral voice rumbles around you, moaning a single word: "Light." The voice fades, and silence returns. A sharp wind whips through the stone chamber. From deep caves and tunnels comes the sound of frogs croaking, rising in volume... and gradually, eerily forming SPOKEN WORDS. "$P," croak the voices. "You have restored the Great Fabozz to his true place, where the sun may again reach him." The frog-croaking becomes deeper and more random for a moment, then sett

26.name: Fritz
26.look: a strong-looking blond man in tattered Earth clothes.
26.hello: "Mein Gott! It is a civilized man! Another outer-world man trapped in zis primordial hole. Velcome to Hell, stranger." "Ah. It is ze Earth-Hero-Gone-Native." He snorts.

qa.a: "I am Fritz von Hundlaben. I am from Munich."
"Ja? Wvat?"
He smiles mockingly. "I am ze world's worst chooser of employers. Actually, I am an archaeologist." "Until recently I vas assistant to Dr. Johann @Spector. Not a real job, but an amazing simulation."
"Ja, Spector. A brilliant man. Archaeologist, anthropologist, geologist. I vent on many digs vith him. And it is my @fault zat he went mad."
"Haff I not told you uf the crystal brain before? Spector thought it wvas zome kind uf memory device. But then, Spector wvas a loon."
"Ja. It vas zis human-like hand made of gold. Very valuable. But he took it vis him somevere, I believe. He said he intended to put it back wvere it came from."
"I found a gold head once, but @Spector took it from me."
"Ja, I haff zome rifle ammunition in my cave. No rifle -- Johann destroyed it wven I called him ein fruitcake."

"Ja, there are many native tribes in zis vicinity. Pindiros to ze southeast of my cave, Barako to ze southwest. Others to ze far south." "Ve didn't get along wven I first came here, but I haff convinced them zat I am a worthy warrior. Zey don't know anything about boxing here. Now I am highly respected."
"Nein, nein, I vill just stay around here. This way I know I wvont run into @Spector again.
"Vell, return wvenever you wish. It is quite a treat for me to speak to a civilized human being."
"Pardon? My English is not so good."
"Vell, if you vish."
"Gut. It vas a long, long story ze first time."

27.name: Grugorr
27.hello: The Neanderthal peers nearsightedly at you; his nostrils flare. "New smell. Strange smell. Not scared. Not mad. What wants new smell?" "Smell of $P in air. Does $P have shield?" "Smell of $P in air. Grugorr greets $P."

qa.a: He pounds on his chest proudly. The concussion dislodges small rocks from the cave ceiling. "Grugorr."
"Chief. Chief of Haakur. Protect Haakur from @Jukari and @spiders."
"Haakur tribe. Strongest. Live caves. Other tribes stupid: Build weak caves. Ha!"
"Jukari build huts outside. Stupid. Live where hot rock rivers run. Stupid! Attack Haakur. STUPID!"
"Spider cave south, along cliff. Full of spiders. Full of webs. Shield of Krukk there." "Kill spiders. Destroy @webs. Bring shield of Krukk to Grugorr. Then Grugorr make ally with other tribes."
"Webs too sticky. Can't break. Can't hurt. Just sticky." "Grugorr heard torches hurt webs. Haakur no have torches. Torches hurt Haakur."
"Grugorr gave word. $P kept word. Killed spiders. Brought shield. Haakur will join $P union of tribes."
He looks sad. "Krukk was son of Grugorr. Brave warrior. Went kill spiders. Spiders kill Krukk."
"Go."
"Grugorr not care."
He peers closely at your gear.
He twists his lip in irritation and pretends to ignore you.

28.name: Guoblum
28.look: a drunken, monstrously overweight, friendly woman.
28.hello: "Ho! Handsome man. Perhaps he will stay with us." She gives you a flirtatious look over the rim of the bowl she is drinking from. "The Disquiqui need more good, strong men among us." "(Hic) Greetings again! Perhaps $P will have some pulque."

qa.a: She indicates herself. "Guoblum." She pronounces it GWO-blum.
"Yes? What does strange warrior want?"
She has to think about that. Then she brightens up. "Drinking @pulque! Guoblum also dances. Guoblum is chief's daughter. Guoblum will soon be bride of @Jimmy Malone."

"Guoblum belongs to Disquiqui tribe. Disquiquis are the happiest tribe." She smiles and takes another drink from her bowl. "@Chafblum is chief of Disquiqui. @Larrifin is shaman. @Lerei is best friend of Guoblum. @Tuomaxx is drum-maker. No, wait, Tuomaxx is gone." Another partygoer cuts in: "Friend! Lerei hates Guoblum." "That was Lerei. Joking, of course."

"Jimmy Malone? Guoblum knows the name of Jimmy Malone. Jimmy Malone will soon be Guoblum's mate. We will be wed when this celebration ends." Jimmy speaks up, whispering: "Lucky for me, celebrations NEVER end around here." Guoblum smiles sweetly. "Guoblum heard that, mate-to-be Jimmy. Chafblum will call a halt in celebration when Guoblum is ready to marry Jimmy."
"Lerei is friend of Guoblum. Poor, sad thing. Skinny like tree, ugly like lizard." "So says Guoblum, from whom the lizards run in fear!" "That was Lerei. Brave girl. Pretends not to be hideous."
"Pulque." She offers you a sip from her bowl. "Pulque is very very very very good." It smells like celery that has been out in the sun for a few days too many. Do you drink it?
"Guoblum's father is Chafblum. Wisest man in all the world. He is chief of Disquiqui. Brews the best pulque in all the world."

"Guoblum remembers Tuomaxx. No, she doesn't. Yes, she does. (Hic!)" "Tuomaxx is of Disquiqui tribe. Round warrior. All pulque in village would not make him drunk. Makes drums. Hits tribesmen with drumsticks." "Makes 'bonk' noise when hitting warriors. Very strange. Tuomaxx is exile now. Lives on hill somewhere east."

"Larrifin. Shaman of Disquiqui. Very bald and old. Guoblum would not marry him." She bats her eyes at you. "Hey, boss, looks like you've got a special new friend..." "Guoblum is just trying to make Jimmy Malone jealous! Jimmy Malone has no sense."
"Guoblum remembers Myrmidex. Ugly warriors from far away. Don't drink pulque. Don't dance. Guoblum doesn't like them."
She doesn't even notice you turning away from her.
"Guoblum does not know about that."

The taste of the stuff jolts through you, clears your sinuses, burns your throat, causes ringing in your ears, and brings tears to your eyes. And it TASTES like celery that has been out in the sun for a few days too many. Guoblum smiles sweetly. "Very mild batch. Ask Guoblum's father for the good stuff."
She draws back, looking disappointed. "Make Guoblum sad. Perhaps she will offer you nothing else." She bats her eyes at you coquettishly.

29.name: Halawa
29.look: a weary, handsome native woman with regal bearing.
29.hello: Her eyes grow wide as she sets sight on you and your companions. "It is $P, the rescuer of Halisa! When Halisa returned to the village, she told Halawa of $P." "Halawa, Queen of the Barako, owes $P a great debt for rescuing Halisa from the giant ape-thing. Come: $P must talk with Halawa." "Spirits' blessings on the stranger," she says. She looks sad and distracted. She looks eagerly at you and those around you, and then seems to slump. "The warrior from beyond has not found young Halisa. So it is. What does the warrior want now?" "Spirits blessing on $P, who saved Halisa from the giant ape-thi

qa.a: "Halawa, mother of @Halisa."
"Yes?"
"Halawa is queen of the Barako tribe. Her daughter @Halisa will be queen in times to come."
"Halawa belongs to the Barako tribe, Mountain-Dwellers of the North."
"Halisa is Halawa's daughter... as $P already knows. $P rescued Halawa from the horrid ape-thing."
"There is an old shaman who bears that name. Topuru lives on a small island just west of the Barako village. Topuru talks like one sun-touched."
"Halawa knows of the Myrmidex. They live to the south, fierce ant-things. Halawa fears that if they destroy the tribes to the south, they will next move against the Barako."

"Unite? Tribes unite? Why would we wish to do that? We have old hatred with the other tribes, especially the @Pindiro." "Still... $P has rescued Halisa. Halawa owes $P a great debt of gratitude. For rescuing Halisa, Halawa will unite her tribe with the others... even the Pindiro."
"The Pindiro run the plains and stay away from the mountain slopes. They live far north and east of the Barako, in a village by the lake."
"Spirits bless you, $P-rescuer-of-Halisa."
"Halawa knows nothing of this."

30.name: Halisa
30.look: a cute, energetic teenaged native girl.
30.hello: "This great, strange warrior has come to rescue Halisa!" Delighted, she runs up and gives you a brief hug. "Come! Halisa will race strange warrior to Barako village. Halisa knows fastest way. Will even wait until warrior is out of sight to give warrior a head start!" "Halisa sees the mighty warrior and rescuer, $P the Great!"

qa.a: "Halisa." She seems both shy around and fascinated by you.
She smiles shyly at you and nods.
"Halisa is learning to be queen of the Barako tribe, as her @mother is."
"Halawa is queen of the @Barakos, and is Halisa's mother."

"There are two tribes in the north. One is Halisa's own tribe, the @Barakos, south of where the mighty hunter rescued Halisa." "There are also the @Pindiro, who are further north, near the waterfall lake." "Oh, and there is mad @Topuru."
"Topuru is a shaman who lives alone on an island, west of the Barako village. But Topuru is not a whole tribe."
"Halisa knows little of the Pindiro tribe. We have fought with them for as long as Halisa can remember. Halisa does not understand why."
"Halisa belongs to the Barako tribe. The Barako live on the plains in the northern part of the valley."
"Candy? What is candy?"
"That is a question for the queen, Halawa; Halisa doesn't know."
"Oh. Well, perhaps you will talk with Halisa later."
"Halisa does not know about that."

31.name: Huitlapacti
31.look: a rather sullen, jewelry-bedecked Nahuatla man.
31.hello: The man looks at you with contempt. "You may not speak with Huitlapacti until you have received permission from Zipactriotl, you scabrous dog," he says, then ignores you. The man's sullen, disinterested eyes briefly fix on you. "What do you want, insignificant one?"

qa.a: "Shake and cringe before the thunder and majesty of my name. I am Huitlapacti." (He pronounces it wheat-la-PACK-tea.) "Huitlapacti, the ruler of all I behold, vanquisher of the enemy, destroyer of the weak, master of the brutes of the forests and plains."
He scowls at you. "'Job'? Do you imagine that I perform labor? I am the king! I rule. I dominate. I conquer." "I scatter lesser men, such as yourselves, as corn before the reaping-blade."

A thought appears to penetrate his consciousness. "Wait. You are not one of my subjects. You have not shown me proper deference. You have not knelt before me, nor licked clean the dusty soles of my feet!" "You must die. Guards! Kill this man!"

32.name: Inara
32.look: a sharp-eyed matriarch with greying hair.
32.hello: "Another @stranger. Word has reached the Pindiro that such a warrior roams the valley. What does the stranger want among the Pindiro?" "The warrior comes before us. Welcome, $P." "It is $P come before us again. What does $P wish?"

qa.a: "The warrior addresses Inara."
"Inara is queen of the Pindiro @tribe."
"The Pindiros are plains-runners. We live free on the open plains, hunting @beasts of the field and @fish of the water." "Our enemies are the @Barakos."
"The Pindiro are the best hunters of the plains. Pindiro warriors are strong and tireless."
"Many of our people pull fish from the rivers, and paddle @rafts out into the great lake to hunt the larger fish that live there."
"It is dangerous to go into the great lake without a raft and four people with @paddles. The creatures under the water will eat any warrior they find swimming."
"The Disquiqui make our paddles. They are a strange tribe, far to the south."
"The Barakos live to the west and south. They dwell on the slopes of the mountain. They come into Pindiro territory too often; we beat them back."

"West of the Pindiro village, along the northern cliff face, is a cave where lives a strange man... a man as strange as he whom Inara now addresses." "His skin and clothes are odd. He fights without spear or knife, but only with clenched fists. Yet no Pindiro warrior can stand before him."
"Inara knows of one with that name. An old shaman. Topuru lives on a small island west of the @Barako village."
"Inara has already decided to join $P's union of tribes."
"$P Peace-Bringer is welcome here. $P may return any time."
"Inara knows nothing of $Z."

33.name: Intanya
33.look: a native man wearing an elaborate jaguar headdress.
33.hello: "You are returning to wakefulness. It is good." "Intanya's potion is powerful magic. It has granted you the speech of the people of this valley. Now you may understand what is said to you." "In fevered ravings, you spoke much of @Aiela, our chieftain's daughter, as well as a @Rafkin and a @Jimmy. Intanya thinks you must find them as soon as possible." "But the valley is full of danger. Before Intanya can let $P rise again and search for his comrades, Intanya must ask $P a question, to see if his mind has healed as well as his body." "The spirits tell Intanya that someone here is unwell." "Inta

qa.a: "Long has the name Intanya been borne.&
"Intanya is shaman to the Kurak tribe. Intanya consults the @spirits; he also @heals the ill and injured."
The shaman gestures around him. "This is the Kurak tribe. Aloron is our chief; $P should go and speak with him."
"The Myrmidex are strange, fierce warriors. Insects of great size, they attack and kill our warriors without cause."

"Intanya is friends with many warriors from many tribes. They travel the valley, seeking out the unknown and telling all to Intanya." Shamuru interrupts: "It is true, $P. Shamuru has been long been a friend of Intanya, and helped Intanya in many things, though Shamuru is not of the Kurak tribe. Many other warriors do the same."
"Triolo came into the valley many moons ago. Intanya made Triolo his assistant, and has been teaching him the secrets of the Shaman."

"The story of the glowing plates on the ground has been handed down from shaman to shaman for more generations than Intanya can count." "Legends say the plates are very dangerous. Any person who walks upon one dissapears and never returns."
"You speak of the powder used in appeasing spirits. It is powerful, best left to shamans."
"Pinde is used to help guide spirits and produce visions."
"Strong flavor and smell. Brings light, calms animals, many other spells, when invoking the right spirits."
"Totems are used to invoke the spirits."
"Aphaz is the spirit of emotions, and strength."
"Motazz is the spirit of battle."
"That is the spirit of knowledge and visions."

His eyes narrow. "Intanya knows from his dreams that $P has been to dream-land called Britannia, and bears important title there. The dreams say $P is a mighty warrior and hero." "Intanya knows more than that. Much more." There is laughter in his eyes, but he does not elaborate.
"Intanya has great powers of healing."
"Intanya knows much about magic, the invoking of @spirits to perform many kinds of magics. He has taught some of these to Triolo."

"There are many spirits in the Valley of Eodon: Spirits of trees and winds, spirits of animals and life." "Intanya senses how the spirits feel and tells his fellows; Intanya draws on the powers of the spirits to @heal those who must be healed."

"Aiela is a great treasure. Intanya knows that her father is grateful to $P for returning her to the Kurak." "Warriors search the valley for Aiela. The Urali are well hidden, and the spirits will not tell Intanya where they lie." "And yet, the spirits do promise that someone will find her. You should speak with Aloron, our chieftain, if you wish to aid in the search."
"He is with $P now."
"The Disquiqui are happy people, but their shaman does not know much. They live far from here, west of the great stone city of the @Nahuatla."
"The Nahuatla call their stone city 'Tichticatl'. They are very proud of it. They live south of the @Yolaru village."
"The Yolaru are dark-skinned warriors. Their village is about a day's travel east of here."
"He is with $P now."
"May the spirits protect you, $P Ava-Tar."
"$P must learn of $Z by himself."

The shaman looks pleased. "Intanya sees that $P's memory has returned, and he is fit to travel the land again." He becomes very serious. "Intanya has had many dreams of one such as $P. Intanya believes $P to be very important." "Intanya's @men will try to follow $P and perhaps help $P when he is in danger. Intanya's men are the best in all the Valley of Eodon, and can find $P anywhere... even in the Caves of the @Myrmidex" "My student, @Triolo, will join you on your search for @Jimmy and @Rafkin. He has learned some of the simpler invocations, and will help you as much as he can." "Speak now. $P may ask what he wishes."

34.name: Jumu
34.look: a youthful warrior trying to look dignified.
34.hello: "Spirits' blessings on the strange visitor.& He looks at you closely. "The strange visitor from no known tribe.& "Hail mighty $P, who returned to us the sacred hide!& The chieftain's face lights up as he sees the sacred hide in $Y's inventory. "The sacred hide of the Jukari is returned!& With obvious relief, he takes the hide and examines it carefully. Satisfied that it is undamaged, he carefully folds it and tucks it away. "The Jukari owe you a great debt, mighty $P.& "Spirits' blessings on the $P.& He looks depressed. "Jumu hears that $P has not yet found the way to the sacred hide.& "Spirit

qa.a: "Jumu the Fearless, Jumu the All-High.&

"Jumu is chief of the Jukari tribe. Jumu has been chief several days already.& "And Jumu's first great task has been accomplished, by Jumu's great friend $P: The sacred hide is returned to Jumu's people.&
"Ours is the Jukari tribe. We are one with the mountains, with the hills which spit fire, with the ground that shakes, with the boulders that roll.&
"Far to the east of the Jukari village is our sacred cave. Was a long journey, even before the flowing rock came. The spirits would speak to our @shaman there, when shaman was alive.&

"Rock that flows from the shaking mountains. Very hot, glows at night. We cannot pass over it.& Rafkin says: "You know, my boy, I once knew a man by the name of James Wildman. He used to tell a story about using a fire extinguisher to cross the superheated deck of a burning ship.& "While lava is considerably hotter, this technique might still prove viable. Chances are that the lava will re-melt fairly quickly, though.& "I had a fire extinguisher in my lab.&
"We have not yet chosen a @shaman to care for the sacred hide, which you returned to us.&
"We have no shaman. Old shaman died when mountain spirits became angry and threw stones down on him.&
"He who wants diamonds and emeralds of the Jukari must go to the sacred @cave.&
"Unite? Unite with other tribes? Jumu does not like to fight other tribes.& "Since $P has brought the sacred hide back to the Jukari, Jumu will ally himself with $P and $P's union of tribes.&
"Walk with the spirits' blessing, oh $P, friend of the Jukari.&
"Jumu does not understand that.&

35.name: Katalkotl
35.look: a tall, elegant reptile man with intelligent eyes.
35.hello: "Greetingss to the visitor." The thing's accent is strange, but its words are understandable. "I am pleased to welcome you again."

qa.a: "I am Katalkotl. Rather, I am a memory of Katalkotl. I know much of the true @Katalkotl."

"I am a sspeaker of memories. Assk me and you will hear many interessting sstoriess." Prof. Rafkin reaches out to touch the reptile, but his hand goes clean through it. "I thought it looked a little translucent... this is amazing, my boy! This is no physical object at all, but some sort of projected image!" "Yess, it is true. I am a memory and a sspeaker of sstories." "I have had little opportunity to tell my sstories since the Kotl left. The only @sstranger here will not lissten to me." "I know sstoriess about the @Kotl, the @Myrmidex, @humans, and the real @Katalkotl."
"I am the image of @Katalkotl, who was of the Kotl race."

"Katalkotl was a member of the Kotl race in the disstant passt. He was a great explorer." "When the Myrmidex rebelled against the Kotl and fled, the Kotl needed new sservantss. Katalkotl led a force of Kotl out into the world to find those sservantss." "Katalkotl wandered the world, visiting many human tribes. He perssuaded many to come back to the city of the Kotl and serve the Kotl." "For bringing a new generation of sservantss to the Kotl, the Kotl honored Katalkotl by placing his image here, for all time. I am that image."
"There iss a human here in the city. He walkss by and ignoress me. He has sspoken to me very little. He doess not believe what I ssay." "His name is Spector."
"Would you care to hear the hisstory of the Kotl?"
"The city is powered by mystical generator crystals which draw their power from the black sstone." "They are really quite beautiful. Would you like to see them?"

"The Myrmidex were bred from antss. The Kotl thought that the Myrmidex might inherit the industriouss nature of the antss. But the Myrmidex also inherited the warlike nature of the antss." "The Myrmidex left the Kotl city, taking with them the giant black sstone which @powerss the city. The city continuess to draw power from the sstone, though it is far away." "The Myrmidex came back centuriess later, and killed mosst or all of the Kotl."

"The humanss were brought here from many different tribess from the outer world." "The Kotl created a language from all their languages and taught it to all the humanss, for the Kotl tongue cannot be sspoken by human throatss. The created language is that which I sspeak now." "But the humanss were independent of heart, and chose to esscape into the upper world. I do not know what became of them. This was centuriess ago." "The Kotl were left behind with only their @automatonss as sservants... until the @Myrmidex came back."

"The automatonss are like sstatues... but made to walk and talk through a mysstic power." "I see there is one with you now, my old friend Yunapotli." "It is true, Kat-al-kot-l. I ac-com-pa-ny these no-ble souls a-round the ci-ty." "It is good that you found Yunapotli. He is the besst and the most intelligent of the automatonss."
"Goodbye. You are welcome to return anytime."
"Nothing of $Z is in my memory."
"Then I will not sspeak it."
"Perhapss you will visit them later, then."

"Near where you entered the city, there is a cluster of transportation plates. Step onto the south central plate." "You will find yourself in the southern portion of the city. Walk east and then south as far as you can." "Move east until you can enter the complex corridors where the @humans used to live. Work your way north through the hallways as far as you can." "It can be confusing... you may find it easiest to ssimply follow the left wall." "Move wesst until you find a transportation plate. Step onto the plate. You will find the generator chamber to the east."

36.name: Kipotli
36.hello: "You. You. I wish to speak to you. Do not turn away. I am a prisoner here. You are an intruder here. We have something in common. Both ignore the laws of Huitlapacti and Zipactriotl. What do you want?" "You again! You did not free me. You SHOULD NOT have betrayed me!" "Guards! Guards! Guards!" He shrieks at the top of his lungs.

qa.a: "I am Kipotli. Kipotli the Fierce. Kipotli the Red. Kipotli the Slayer. Kipotli the Untamed." Jimmy whispers in your ear: "Kipotli the Redundant." Kipotli snarls. "What does he say?"
"Bow when you speak my name!"
"I am a warrior. I slay the savages. I slay the giant lizards. I slay Nahuatla officers. I slay anyone. But now I am a @prisoner. So is @Oaxtepac."
"I am of the Nahuatla."

"They told me that I should stop killing my own officers. I told them, 'Nobody tells me that!' and killed THEM." "Then more came and said, 'Why did you do this?' And I said, 'I don't answer questions!' and killed THEM." "Then more came, with nets, and I couldn't kill all of them. So I am here. But now you are here, you will have to @free me."
"Don't say 'No' to me. I might have to kill you, too. Instead, you should @free me."
"Yes, free me. I will @join you. I will kill all your enemies, and mine too. Just leave the door open. I'll be your friend forever. Yes, yes. Will you free me?"
"Oaxtepac, the Shaman? Yes, he is here, near me. Behind a solid door, a door with no window. You don't want him. He is weak."
"Join!? With one so pathetic as you? I only said that to get you to set me free. You must pay for your arrogance! Kipotli will kill everyone!"

"No, you can't go away. You must free me. You must tell me now whether you will free me. If you do not, I will call the guards. I can scream so loudly they will hear me, and come. Now, will you free me or not?"
"I do not care about that. I want you to @free me."
"Good! Just slide the door bolt. Yes, yes."
"No? No? Then I cannot kill you myself. I suppose I will just have to watch the guards doing it." He begins screaming at the top of his lungs. "Guards! Guards!"

37.name: Ksssindra
37.look: a stooped, aged female reptile with cunning eyes.
37.hello: "Sssoo. Ssstrange huuman here, beloonging to no tribe. Mussst be cautiousss.& "Sssoo. Ssstrange warrior $P isss here again.&

qa.a: "Ksssindra is name.&
"Ksssindra haas no tasssks now. Ksssindra wasss once traaveler and waarrior. Tooo oold now. @Teachesss young oness.&
"Ksssindra is of Sssakkhra tribe. We aare fiercer than liizard, smaarter than huuman.&
"Yeeesss. Ksssindra teachesss. Shoows young oness @landmarkss of the Sssakkhra. Teells of @legendss.&
"Maaany landmarksss for young Sssakkhra to learn. @Medicine trees, @Mesas.&
"Maaany legends for young Sssakkhra to learn. @City under the earth is one.&
"Yeeess. In Sssakkhra caves is big blue rock. Sssakkhra hit it with hammer, make sssmall blue rocks. Maake jewelry of sssmall blue rocks.&
"Green fruit grows on trees in north part of this valley. Many would travel to them, before the @Thunderer caame.&
"Leegend say that Sakkhra once liived uunder ground, in huuge ciity. Near great @mesa. Lossst now.&
"Three mesas in thiis land. Great mesa and small mesa nearesst Sakkhra caves. No oone lives on theese mesas. Barrab mesa farther aaway. @Barrab tribe lives on.&
"Thunderer. Biig lizard. Ksssindra hass heard that $P hasss killed the Thunderer. Thiss is goood.& Eats Sssakkhra who go near.&
"Huumans, like you. Liive on eassternmosst @mesa.&
The lizard nods and turns away from you.
"Ksssindra not understandss.&

38.name: Larrifin
38.hello: "What? What?& He's sawing two sticks together and doesn't look as though he wants to be interrupted. "What? What?& He's still sawing his two sticks together.

qa.a: "Who is asking?& he sneers. "Tell our visitor your name, or Chafblum will hit you so hard your hair will be straight.& "Oh. That is different. I am Larrifin.&
"WHAT?!&
"Larrifin is shaman of whole tribe. Larrifin is famous @healer.&
He nods sagely. "Yes, Larrifin agrees.&
"Talk to chief about that.&
"This is Disquiqui tribe. Happiest tribe.&
"You like sticks? @Tuomaxx make sticks.&
"Echo?&
"Echo!&
"Yes, Larrifin is great healer.& He looks nervous. "Uh... does one here need healing?&
"Good idea. You make distraction and Larrifin will escape.&
He nods sagely. "Yes, Larrifin agrees.&

"Oh.& He looks uncomfortable. "Then Larrifin must heal.& He puts down his sticks. He pats around his fur garments, then brightens up. "Larrifin does not have his spirit-tokens! Cannot heal.
