Sorry.& "Larrifin does not even know how to heal! Larrifin is rotten shaman.& "Liar! That woman was withered crone until Larrifin healed her.& "Larrifin has that backwards. Larrifin gets his hands on a woman, she turns into a withered crone.& "Oooh, she will be sorry the next time she has a splinter. No one can take out a splinter as Larrifin can.&
He breathes a sigh of relief. "Good.&

39.name: Lerei
39.hello: "Ah, it is a strange warrior. What would a real warrior want among the Disquiqui?& She gives you a long, curious look. "Ah. Against all sense, $P has returned to the Disquiqui.&

qa.a: "Lerei. Often called Lerei-of-not-enough-Plachta.&

"Lerei is in charge of feeding the prisoners. It is usually very easy, for our warriors are not good enough to capture anyone. But now Lerei must work, for we have a prisoner.& "In fact, there he is. Hello, Jimmy.& "Hello, doll. You're a rotten cook.& "Lerei has never been in charge of a prisoner before! How did Jimmy get out?& "$P here staged a jailbreak. I'm escaping, see. Care to come along?& "Maybe if it were just $P. But if Jimmy is going along, Lerei will stay here.&
She looks around, incredulous. "Can you imagine that Lerei would stay here if she were not one of the Disquiqui?&
"Stir-fried chocolate-chameleon-and-parrot? It's my speciality!&
"Good choice. Better anywhere than Disquiqui village.&
"Lerei doesn't understand $Z.&

40.name: Moctapotl
40.look: a hard-eyed man in Aztec-like clothes.
40.hello: "Beware, stranger, if you mean me harm. I am a mighty @fighter.& "I am pleased to see the warrior $P, who restored me to my throne.& "It is $P, who has promised to set me on my throne again. Yet here I am, still an exile among the Disquiqui.& "Ah. It is the strange warrior from beyond. I greet you in peace.&

qa.a: "My name is Moctapotl.&
"I am the true king of the Nahuatla.& "For a time, I was merely an exile... but with your help, I have become king once again.&
"I belong to the @Nahuatla race, far more civilized than all the @others in the valley.&
"I am a fighter of fame and prowess. I have fought the warlike Yolaru and Kurak @tribes and the deadly @Myrmidex.&
"I am no longer an exile, thanks to you.&

"Zipactriotl came from nowhere, surrounded by a glow which no weapon could pierce. He gave a similar glow to @Huitlapacti, and suddenly no warrior... not even I... could harm Huitlapacti.& "Between them, Zipactriotl and Huitlapacti captured the old shaman @Oaxtepac, and nearly captured me. I escaped.& "Fortunately, those dark days are over.& "And so I stay here, among the Disquiqui, and hope to find some way of regaining my throne.&
"Huitlapacti was a madman. How fortunate that he is dead.&
"Oaxtepac is shaman of the Nahuatla.&
"Tlapatla is my cousin. Unfortunate for her that she was married to that madman Huitlapacti.& "... but fortunate for her that you came to depose Huitlapacti and separate him from his life.&

"The Myrmidex. Yes, they are fierce.& "We have spoken on them in the past, and I have already agreed to help you against them.& "We have spoken on them in the past, and I have agreed to help you against them... once Huitlapacti is cast down, and I am once again on the throne of Tichticatl.& "No single tribe can stand against them... and no one, not even I, can seem to @unite the tribes against them.&
"There are many other tribes in the valley. @Barrab, @Disquiqui, @Haakur, @Jukari, @Kurak, @Pindiro, @Sakkhra, @Yolaru, and @Urali. Which do you wish to learn of?&
"The Kurak are good fighters. They live to the northwest."
"Dark-skinned, fierce fighters, the Yolaru live north of Tichticatl.&

"The Disquiqui tribe is in the lowlands to the west of Tichticatl. They are a merry tribe, but nearly worthless in war.& With a sigh, he gestures around him. "These foolish people are the Disquiqui. They have been kind enough to shelter me during my exile.&
"Out to the west, through a narrow defile, are the Barrab, dwellers in the clouds -- atop a high mesa.&
"To the far west, near the Barrab, are the Sakkhra. They are reptile men, and fierce fighters.&
"Southeast, in the land of the volcanoes, are the Jukari, who are stupid enough to live among the mountains that spit lava.&
"Ugly and slow, but very strong. The Haakur live to the southeast, near the Jukari.&
"North, in the distance, are the Pindiro and the Barako. I do not know much of them.&

"Somewhere east are the Urali. I do not know where they live. For centuries, they have kept themselves apart.& "Recently, a new chief has sent them out against the Nahuatla; they may turn out to be a worthwhile enemy.&
"I am of the Nahuatla people. Our city is called Tichticatl. It is a great city, all made of stone.&
"I have already agreed to aid you when you bring the tribes together. This is the debt I owe you. This, and nothing more.&
"Goodbye, friend $P.&
"I know nothing about that.&

41.name: Mosagann
41.look: a lean, elegant man wearing shamanistic paints.
41.hello: He appears to be chanting to himself and counting on his fingers, but it's hard to tell. He gives you a quick look, obviously hoping that you'll go away, and tries to ignore you. "Mosagann is still busy, $P.&

qa.a: "Mosagann is my name. Do not interrupt.&
"Shaman. Father of @Sahree. Go away. Very busy now.&
"Yes, very busy.&
"No, too busy to trade now.&
"Yolaru tribe.& He nods quickly. "We are Yolaru. Go find someone else to talk to.&

His face breaks into a smile and he stops his chanting and counting. "Yes, Sahree is my daughter. Sahree is a fine she-warrior. A better warrior than the men of the Yolaru.& "Sahree is beautiful and clever as her mother, as busy as her father.& He taps his chest, indicating himself. "Busy.& A thought occurs to him. He begins to look distracted again. "Go away. Mosagann is busy.&
"Apaton. Chief of the Yolaru. Go speak to Apaton.&
"Speak to Mosagann again when you have less time.&
He sighs and ignores you.

42.name: Nakai
42.hello: The boy just lies there and moans piteously. "You may speak to Nakai. Nakai is to be chief someday but @Father says Nakai must be humble anyway.& "This one is told that it is $P who made him well. $P has Nakai's thanks.& "It is $P, who made Nakai well! Ask anything of Nakai. Nakai is to be @chief someday, so Nakai knows a lot.&

qa.a: "This one is Nakai, son of @Balakai.& He indicates himself. "Nakai has a @sister, Nakola.&
"This one is to be Chief of the Barrab, when he is of age. So this one trains in weapons and with the words of wisdom of his @ancestors.&
"$P knows of ancestors. Long-dead parents of parents, and aunts and uncles of parents, and THEIR parents and aunts and uncles, back to the beginning of time.&
"Nakai's father @Balakai knows all about blue stones. $P will have to ask him.&
"The Thunderer is what the @Sakkhra call a giant lizard which is eating them up.&

"The Sakkhra are man-shaped lizards. They look fierce but they are much like people. Nakai used to play with a Sakkhra hatchling when Nakai was a boy.& "The Sakkhra now have problems with a lizard, the @Thunderer.&
"Balakai is Nakai's father. He is so wise that he is not only the chief of the Barrab, he is their shaman, too. Nakai doesn't want to be shaman. Too much to learn.&
"Nakai once met a @Disquiqui man named Tuomaxx. He made drums. He was strange. Balakai made him go away. Ask @Balakai about him.&
"Nakai knows all about Nawl. Nawl is such a big liar. Nakai's little @sister Nakola beat him up once. If $P ever sees Nawl, ask him about Nakola.&

"Nakai does not know about many tribes. We are the Barrab, who live atop the mesa.& "West are the @Sakkhra, who are very interesting.& "East, through a gap in the cliffs, $P will find many other tribes.& "Nakai has met several of the @Disquiqui, including @Tuomaxx.&

"They live just beyond the gap in the cliffs to the east. Go through the gap and turn north, and you will find them. They are very friendly.& "They are not very fierce. Nakai can defeat their mightiest warrior. So can his @sister.&

"Nakai has a little sister, her name is Nakola. She is hiding because $P is a stranger. Nakai does not think she will come out while $P is here.& "She used to like to leap out from behind trees at Disquiqui warriors, and scare them. But our father told her to stop. She also beat up a warrior named @Nawl once.&
"Oh. Nakai is sorry $P must go. Come back and we will talk more. Nakai must learn all there is if Nakai is to be chief someday.&
"$P will have to ask @Balakai about that.&

43.name: Nawl
43.hello: "I know you, or one like you. You are a warrior of the @Haakur, are you not?&

qa.a: "I knew it. I can always tell one of the @Haakur, even when they conceal their true natures.&
He sighs. "If you wish to pretend, I will not stop you, my @Haakur friend. But you must know your disguise is a poor one. What do you want?&
"I am Nawl of the @Barrab tribe. I am the most clever warrior of the most clever tribe. My cunning is legendary. I know everything. And I never boast.&
"Yes, I am Nawl.&
"My duty is to wander the land and learn all there is to learn. There is not one corner of these valleys I have not seen, not one cave I have not visited, not one @enemy I have not defeated.&
"Haakur? I need not tell YOU of the Haakur. You need not pretend you are not one of that tribe. You cannot fool the cunning Nawl. Do not try.&
"Yes, the cunning Nawl is of the Barrab tribe, the greatest tribe of all. We are more mighty, more clever than all other men.&

"The mighty Barrab tribe has the only blue stone in all the land. It is that stone which makes us the greatest tribe.& "Not that we would be any less great without it. Ask the chieftain, @Balakai, about the blue stone.&

"Yes, Balakai. He is the shaman and chief of the Barrab, the greatest tribe. He is the master of the @blue stone.& "In the land of the three mesas you will find him, for he and the rest of the Barrabs live atop one of the mesas.& "I am not allowed -- er, I do not visit there often, I cannot show you the way.&
"You speak to the greatest warrior ever born. The cunning Nawl HAS no enemies. I have conquered or enslaved them all.&
"The Myrmidex? I know them. I lived among them for many years. A kindly race of dull-wits. I almost married their princess. I seem to remember they are very homely.&
"I know them well, the Nahuatla." * "They... uh... when a warrior knows so much he sometimes is slow to remember it all..." * "They are the warriors with the feathers on their heads.&
"Nakola?& His eyes stand out from their sockets. "Is that she-demon here? Oh, no! I said her name! Perhaps she heard me! I must flee!&
"I don't know about that. No, that is not true, the cunning Nawl knows all. They're the Urali. They're the moist warriors from the swamps, are they not? Yes.&

"Yes, there are many tribes in this land other than the mighty @Barrab." * "There are... uh... those who have all the @feathers, and the ones with the sandals, and the ones where it's @wet. And even more than that. I have met them all. I know everything.&

"You wish to unite the mighty Barrab tribe with those lesser races? Hah!& He thinks about it for a long moment. "In truth, that decision is for the chieftain of the @Barrab to make. His name is @Balakai. Please do not tell him that the cunning Nawl said 'Hah.' Though I have no fear of him, or of you either.&
"I've heard of them. I mean, er, the mighty Nawl lived among them for a long time. Nawl could have been their chief. They are one of those other tribes, yes?&
"So, you have learned all you can understand from the cunning Nawl? Return to me sometime when you feel you can learn more!&
"The cunning Nawl knows all about that. But I will tell you nothing. You could not possibly understand it.&

44.name: Oaxtepac
44.look: an elderly man in rich Aztec-like garments.
44.hello: He looks at you narrowly. "You are not @Nahuatla, nor of the other tribes in the Valley of Eodon. What do you wish of me, outsider?" He looks at you narrowly. "You are not @Nahuatla, nor of the other tribes in the Valley of Eodon. And if you have broken down my prison door, you are certainly no friend of Huitlapacti and Zipactriotl." "What do you wish of me?" "It is my friend $P! I am glad to see you again. How may I help you?" "It is my friend and rescuer, $P! I am glad to see you again. As you can see, I have kept out of sight of the guards here and remain free. How may I help you?"

qa.a: "I am Oaxtepac." He pronounces it WASH-tuh-pack.
"Now that the evil mage Zipactriotl has vanished, I am once again the shaman to the @Nahuatla. I interpret the will of the spirits, advising the king."

"The people here are called the Nahuatla, and have been since our most ancient memories. Once, we dwelled far, far away." "Mighty @beings brought us to the valley of Eodon to be their servants, in their hidden @city. Our ancestors rebelled and slew their masters, then built Tichticatl."
"Moctapotl is the true king of the @Nahuatla. He is a stern but just king." "He sits upon his rightful throne once again."

"We and the other tribes of the Valley of Eodon were brought here by mighty beings. The legends say different things about them." "Some say they were the spirits of the valley. Some say they were like the Sakkhra, but wise. Some say they were the great, thundering lizards of the valley, in a time when they had the wisdom of men and much greater power than men."
"We are in the Valley of Eodon. We may never leave; the cliffs are too high to scale."

"This is Tichticatl, the home of the @Nahuatla. It is a town built of stone, the only one in the Valley of Eodon; this is proof that the Nahuatla are a greater race than all the other, savage tribes of the valley."

"The Myrmidex are evil beings, like ants grown to the size of men. They kill and carry off our people. We fight them and fight them, but they always come." "I think that if all men in the Valley, both the great @Nahuatla and the lesser tribes, were to @unite against the Myrmidex, we could beat them. But it has never happened."

"He was briefly king of the @Nahuatla. When the the glow of power that protected him vanished, the people realized he was no longer immortal, and tore him apart like a pack of dogs. Praise be the spirits, he will torment us no more."
"I am honored that you would ask this of me, but I can not join you. My duties are here, among my people."

"The other tribes, the lesser tribes, are these:" "There are the Kurak, Yolaru, and Disquiqui, who live near us. The Kurak and Yolaru are savage but noble, while the Disquiqui are mostly wastrels." "Far to the north are the Pindiro and Barako, who live in the plains. Far to the southwest are the Barrab, who live atop a tall mesa, while southeast are the Jukari, who live near the volcanoes." "Somewhere to the east, we do not know where, live the Urali. They ride mighty lizards and, recently, they raid us like the Myrmidex." "Then there are two races which are not truly like men. The Haakur, far southeast, are nearly men, but bent and brutish. The Sakkhra, far southwest, are lizards who walk like men; they are not men at all."

"The Jukari are a primitive tribe. They live in a wild land southeast of Tichticatl. Leave our city and travel southeast along the path. You will travel through a narrow passage. Keep to the western cliffs and you will find the Jukari."
"The Barrab live a long distance to the west, on a great mesa."
"I truly think it would be possible to unite the tribes against the Myrmidex. But it would take a very great hero, and he would have to persuade each tribal chief to help him."

"Zipactriotl has dissapeared, and with him the glow of power from around @Huitalpacti." "I was until recently the shaman in the king's palace. But not long ago, the being called Zipactriotl came. He was protected by a glow of great power. No dagger, spear or arrow would penetrate it." "He cowed the nobles and warriors, and said that the spirits had sent him to command them. I argued against him. He persuaded many fickle warriors to rise up against me and the king, @Moctapotl." "@Moctapotl is swift, and escaped. I am old and slow, and I was captured, as you can see."

"Yes. As the story goes, the mighty beings which brought the Nahuatla to the Valley of Eodon had a hidden city near the land of the mesas. They brought us there to be their servants." "Then the Nahuatla rebelled and left the city. Left without servants, the mighty beings decided eventually to abandon it. They left it, they closed it, but they left a key behind in case they should ever want to occupy it again." "Do you want to know what the legends say of finding the city?"

"You speak of the head of the golden statue of a man, yes? I believe it was a @Barrab tribesman who I found it on. It was in my possession for many years... until Zipactriotl came." "I showed it to Zipactriotl's servant, a man named @Fritaz. He grew excited and told his master about it." "I imagine that Zipactriotl has it now, either in the treasury or in his quarters in the palace. They were once my quarters."
"Yes, Fritaz, a strange and difficult name. Zipactriotl drove him away in a fit of madness. I do not know where he has gone."
"The giant gem was once in the treasury of the Nahuatla. I would gladly give it to you now, if only I had it. It was stolen away by the Urali, not long ago."
"May the spirits travel with you, great $P." "Fare well, $P. Return here if you ever have another request of me."
"That is something of which I know nothing."

"To find the city, you must go to the land of the mesas, which is southwest of Tichticatl, beyond a narrow pass." "There, you will find three mesas. One is very small. One is larger, and the village of the Barrab is atop it. The last is very large. You must go to the top of the largest mesa." "There, on a promontory on the north of the mesa, you will find a remnant of the beings who built the city. It is a device, a sculpture... I know not what. In that device, you must place a @giant gem, and then wait for many hours." "At a certain time of day, the sunlight will strike the @giant gem and reveal the location of the hidden city. Or so the legend has it." "There is more. The legend says that a strange man guards the entrance to the city, a man made of solid gold!" "I was certain that this must have been another legend, until one day many years ago when I found the @head of such a man in the possession of a captured tribesman. It appears to have been pulled from a golden statue. If the golden man was real, perhaps the city is real."
"Well, perhaps it IS only a legend."

45.name: Pever
45.look: a strong-looking warrior with a lost look in his eyes.
45.hello: "Pever doesn't know you.& "Pever still doesn't know you.&

qa.a: "Pever doesn't know his name.& Aiela speaks up, her voice sad. "Aiela has heard of the great Pever. Pever and Dokray of the Pindiro were great friends. They sought out and hunted Myrmidex.& "One time, Pever was hurt by the Myrmidex. Pever's mind is not his any more. Pever has not wit enough to be a warrior or to hunt the Myrmidex.& "Aiela has heard that Pever does not wish to be reminded of the @Myrmidex.&
He looks at you, obviously quite puzzled.
"Pever has important task. Pever must...& His eyes wander a bit. "Pever does not remember.&
"Myrmidex. Myrmidex? MYRMIDEX!& His eyes grow wide. "Pever hates Myrmidex! Pever kills Myrmidex!& His eyes roll around and then focus on you. "Pever sees a Myrmidex!&
"Talk to Pever later. Soon?& Dokray nods. "Soon, Pever.& Tears fill his eyes as he turns to follow you. "Slay Myrmidex for Pever, Dokray.&
"Pever used to fight $Z. Pever has killed many $Z.&

46.name: Sahree
46.look: a beautiful warrior-woman with a bold look in her eye.
46.hello: "Sahree sees $P, rescuer of @Aiela." She looks very distressed. "Aiela is Sahree's best friend. Often did Aiela join Sahree in exploring, talking, and making trouble." "But Sahree has not seen Aiela for many days. Something bad may have happened to Aiela." "When Sahree was sneaki..." she blushes, then corrects herself. "When Sahree was near the @Kurak village, she heard the warriors there say @Aiela had been captured by Darden the Huge, from the @Urali tribe." "Sahree has searched for the Urali, but their village is hidden... but it must be somewhere to the southeast of the Yolaru village." "S

qa.a: "Sahree is my name, Sahree daughter of @Mosagann."

"Sahree chooses to make trouble wherever there is trouble to be made." Aiela nods reflectively. "Sahree is the best bringer of trouble there is. The spirits stand in awe before her." "Where men say that women should not take up the spear and the bow, Sahree goes and demonstrates warrior's prowess." "Where a bad chief stands in pretended dignity, Sahree hides in the trees and hurls spoor at him." "These are the things Sahree does."
"Sahree is of the Yolaru tribe, great hunters. Our fiercest enemies are the @Kuraks. But Sahree's greatest @friend is of the Kuraks."
"Sahree is of the Yolaru tribe."
"Mosagann, Sahree's father is shaman of the Yolaru tribe."

"$P must know of the Urali already, for did he not rescue Sahree's good friend @Aiela from them?" She looks quite angry. "The Urali are no friend of Sahree, for they have captured Sahree's companion in trouble-making, @Aiela." "Sahree does not know where their tribe is, or she would go there and make trouble for them."
"Kuraks live to the west of the Yolaru. Good warriors. Yolaru fight them all the time. Too often: If we fought the @Myrmidex as often as each other, more Myrmidex would be dead."
She makes a small squeaking sound, then coughs politely. "Sahree has a small cold," she explains."
"Sahree's best friend is Aiela of the @Kurak tribe. But now Aiela is missing. Darden the Huge of the @Urali tribe has captured her."
"Myrmidex are evil ant-things. They live west of the Kurak village. They raid against the people all the time. Kill and eat, kill and eat. @Aiela and Sahree wish to @unite tribes against them."
"Sahree must not talk of trouble. Such things are between Sahree and @Aiela."
"Sahree knows that name. There is one whose true name is Rafkin who acts as the schweitzer of the Yolaru tribe."

"The tribes cannot stand singly before the @Myrmidex. They must unite. Sahree knows this. @Aiela knows this. But Sahree and Aiela cannot persuade their chiefs of this." "There is a legend of one warrior who united the tribes in the past. Has $P heard this story, of Oloro?"
"There is a legend of one warrior who united the tribes in the past. Has $P heard this story, of Oloro?"
"The hill of the drum is northwest of the stone village of the @Nahuatla people. It is a small hill."
"The Nahuatla are a people who build all in stone. Their stone village is southwest of the Yolaru village."
"No, Sahree has plenty to do already."
"Spirits protect you, $P."
She shakes her head, not understanding.
"Good. If only the tribes had an Oloro now, the evil of the @Myrmidex might end."

"Once in the past, the lizards of the jungle became too numerous and fierce, and all tribes were in danger. All men might have been eaten and destroyed." "Yet they would never fight as brothers; when they did not fight the lizards, they fought one another, and even more good warriors died." "One warrior was Oloro-of-no-tribe. Oloro was an exile; Sahree thinks he must have been Yolaru once." "Oloro went from chief to chief and did a mighty service for each one. Each chief promised to unite with former enemies only if some great service were done, and Oloro went out and did that great service." "When each service was done, Oloro went to each chief and said, 'When the sound of the greatest drum there could ever be sounds through the jungle, come to that sound, and we will destroy the fierce lizards." "When all the services were done, he built a great drum on a small hill northwest of the Nahuatla stone village. It is still called @Hill of the Drum." "He beat the drum until all the chiefs and all the warriors assembled. And though there was anger between the warriors, they fought as brothers, and the lizards were killed." "Sahree thinks that a new Oloro could come and do the same, for all the warriors know the story of Oloro. If a great warrior could do a service for each chief, and then build Oloro's drum, the warriors might come." "But the chiefs do not listen to Sahree. Sahree cannot even try to do these great deeds when the chiefs will not listen to her."

47.name: Spector
47.look: a lean, dark-bearded man with shrewd eyes.
47.hello: Spector glares at you. "Oh, you're back. Why do you persist in coming here?" "You cannot hurt me or my mystic @generators. We are too well protected. Do yourself a favor and leave." Spector sighs and rolls his eyes. "Why, it's the ever-inquisitive $P. I take it you've come to annoy me again, like a sleepless child bothering his father for a glass of water." Spector's eyes fall on you and his jaw drops. "It's $P! However did you find my city?" He gapes at you for a moment. "Well, it won't do you any good. These @generators you see around you are protected by the same force @field that protects

qa.a: "I am Dr. Johann Schleimann Spector."
"Yes, yes, Zipactriotl is how the Nahuatla know me."
He nods sagely. "Learn my name well."
He shakes his head. "I am beyond the concern of mere workaday professions. I am the world's only hope for a future @paradise. I am the future master of the @Myrmidex and @conquerer of the world."
"You want to hear about my plan to bring @paradise to Earth?"

"The Myrmidex are a race of ant-like creatures. They're the size of humans and even more ferocious." "They have mutated to human-like intelligence by the power of the black @stone in their possession... the same black stone which powers the mystic generators you see around you."
"I'm not sure what to make of the Kotl. They must have been a @tribe of men in ancient times, but in all their art they represent themselves as man-shaped lizards."
"I'm protected by a force field which is emitted by the @generators you see around you. These energies resonate with a @belt I've made from rare metals I found in this city."
"I wear the belt under my clothes. It also serves to hold my pants up."
"Do you mean the old king, @Moctapotl, or the old shaman, @Oaxtepac?"

"Moctapotl was a fool. He wasn't willing to send his warriors all over the valley looking for clues to help me tap the power of the @Kotl generators. I deposed him. He managed to escape." "I put Huitlapacti on the throne to replace him."

He snarls. "That's what Fritz said. He called me mad. I'll show you mad. Go ahead, poke around, look at everything you want. And when this city rises up to bite you, don't call me for help. I'll laugh as you die!" He turns his back on you and pretends not to hear what you say.
"My plan for bringing @paradise to the Earth."

"Oaxtepac was the shaman of the Nahuatla. I told him to say that the spirits commanded them to find the power-@stone of the Myrmidex, to seek out all sorts of clues." "He refused. So I locked him up in the great pyramid in the city of @Tichticatl."

"The most civilized people in this valley are the Nahuatla. I think their ancestors were also ancestors of the Aztecs." "The other humans in this valley... they're hopeless. Too feral and disorganized to follow orders."
"The new king of the @Nahuatla is Huitlapacti. Nobody wanted him to be king; all he wants to do is have people killed. If he weren't protected by my force @field, they'd rise up and kill him."
"These generators you see in this room are mystic batteries. I don't quite understand how they work. They draw power from the far-away black @stone held by the Myrmidex."

"There are many tribes out there. These Nahuatla are the most civilized of them. I haven't bothered learning the names of the others." "They seem to have been drawn from all over the Earth: Central America, Africa, Asia, lots of places. But they're disorganized and dangerous. Best to destroy or enslave them and get back to business."

"Fritz von Hundlaben was my research assistant and bodyguard. Where did you hear about him? Never mind." He shakes his head. "Fritz was drawn along with me when I reached this valley. But as I began developing my plan for @conquering the Earth, he became... strange. Withdrawn." "He went insane... and convinced himself that I was mad, that my plan was mad. Poor fellow. He just disappeared one day. He's probably out in the jungle somewhere, eating rabbits raw and howling at the moon."

He stiffens. "You know," he says slowly, "in the city of Tichticatl, where I am the shaman, saying the word 'no' to me carries a penalty of death." He smiles thinly. "But I have no guards here. I cannot call for your execution." He reaches out and slaps you across the face. "There," he smiles. "That should hold you until you manage to kill yourself in your explorations of this city."

"I'm certain, from my calculations, that the Myrmidex are in possession of a great black stone such as the small ones which brought me to this valley. I have never seen it... but I'm certain they have it." "The generators in this room draw their power from it, and I've come to believe that a side-effect of the stone's power is causing an odd change in the flow of time within the valley." He shrugs, obviously unconcerned. "I'm certain that if I can bring that stone here, I can use it to implement my plans for bringing paradise to the Earth."
"Which city? @Tichticatl, or the @Underground city of the @Kotl, where you are now?"
"Tichticatl is the city of the Nahuatla. It has many similarities to Maya and Aztec architecture. I'll have to study it at length, once I've @conquered the Earth."

He gestures around him. "Fantastic, isn't it? This city was built by some forgotten people called the @Kotl." "They've left no record behind of their origin or accomplishments." His face twitches; he sounds rather as though he's lying. "They seem to have learned many secrets of mysticism and mystic power. This is another place I will have to study at length once I've @conquered the Earth."
He smiles. "Of course. Go about your business. I'm sure you'll enjoy your stay in the city." He laughs, then turns his attention elsewhere.
"Don't bother me with irrelevancies."
"Then, why did you ask? Oh, never mind." He looks miffed.

48.name: Sysskarr
48.look: a sly but aged male of the reptile men.
48.hello: "Sssoo, you are $P we hear sssoo much offf. You traaavel, you quessst. Now you are in Sssakkhra lands. Whhhat want you heeere, eh?"

qa.a: "You ssspeak to Sysskarr, ssspawn of @Ssslisssith."
"Sysskarr wasss haaatched to be ruler of all @Ssakkhra, and Sysskarr will rule until he falls and wooorms take him." "Sysskarr iss alssso enemy of the @Thunderer."

"We are Sssaakkhra, perfect race. Hiide like aarmor, jawws like death." "There are other triiibes. Nearby are @Barrab, live on top of mesa. Sssometimes we fight, sssometimes we ignore." "Further away, ooother races. Nahuatla with sstone knives and goold. @Disssquiqui by the river, drink and feassst all of time. Kuraaak in the foressst, sssneak around in trees." "Many more even fuurther away, we neever meet. Barako, Yolaaaru, uuugly Haakur, swaampy Urali, faar-away Jukari and Pindiro." "Last, there are @Myrmidex, fierce like ants."
"Ssslisssith was my sssire. Mighty waarior. Ssslew maany Barrab. Worms haave him now."
"Worms taake everyone, wiith time. Why you sssit here and taalk of worms?"
"Yesss, Thunderer. Miighty lizard, taall as mesa, sswift as river. When he waalks, earth ssshakes like thunder. When he roooars, sound breeaks boulders from cliffs and birds die of feeear."
"Sysskarr haass heard of one sssuch. @Dissquiqui haaave him, or uuused to have. Sssay he wearsss ssstrange hidesss, is too ssskinny to eeat."
"To find Disquiqui, taake path to foressst lands. Asss ssoon as in foressst, before reach Nahuatla city, turn north."
"We haate Myrmidex. We kill Myrmidex. They live faaar away, we know not wheere."
"We are Sssaakkhra, perfect race. Hiide like aarmor, jawws like death. Dessscendantsss of the @Kotl."
"You have dessstroyed the Thunderer. Sysssskar will stand by $P when the @drum sounds to unite the tribes."
"Green fruit growsss only on the trees in the north part of thisss valley. Sssstrong medicine for the Ssakkhra. Does nothing for other triibes."
"Kotl. Name of our kind whheen we live in ciiity under ground. Have sssome @power which protectssss them."

"Yesss, Sysskarr has heard of Zipactriotl aand glow which proteeects him and Azzztec king. Sssaakkhra tales ssspeak of glow. Our ancessstors from long, long ago had glow. They were called Kotl." "In aaancient times, ssstory says, Sssaakkhra ancestors, called Kotl, ruule all world, keep huumans as petss. Live in miighty city beneath earth. Have powerful glow, protectss them." "But @Myrmidexxx come and ssscatter them. We now live above grouund, in smaaall caves." "Leegend say, go to top of Great Mesa. Isss northeassst of usss. Find aaancient relic of thoose times. Wiill say where aaancient Sssaakkhra lived. Theere you may fffind sssecret of glow."
"Yesss, there isss such a flower near heere. Go top of Greeeat Mesa, northeassst of us. There find floower."
"Blue sstone iss very nice. @Barrab shaman came to loook once. Ssstruck stone with hammer, made smaller blue stones." "Sysskarr did not care... isss much blue sstone."
"Barrab live on tall mesa farther eassst. Whole villlage on top. Chief is called Balakai. @Balakai also shaman."
"Balakai is tribe chief and ssshaman for Barrab. Fought him once, did Sysskarr, when Sysskarr very old and Balakai very young. Sysskar won. Sssurprised Balakai lived."
"Yesss, go. Too much talk make Sysskarr weary."
"Sysskarr knows noothing of thisss."
"Gooood."
Jimmy whips out his notebook. "Don't strain your brain to remember that, $P-old-pal. I'll just jot it down in my @notebook here."

49.name: Tlapatla
49.look: an unhappy-looking woman wearing Aztec-like clothes.
49.hello: She looks at you wearily. "Oh, it's that $P again." She sighs. "Why have you returned? Nothing ever changes here. No, do not answer that. What do you want?" She looks at you suspiciously. "Stay back! Do you mean me harm?"

qa.a: She screams, "Guards! I am attacked! Your queen is attacked! Guards!" Then she faints.
She relaxes, then looks disinterested. "Oh, very well. I am bored. I will talk with you."
"I am Tlapatla. My cousin is @Moctapotl, the king."
"Yes?"

"I am Queen of all the @Nahuatla. I used to be in charge of all the palace, back when I was a lowly princess, cousin of the king. But since my mad husband took the @throne, I am not allowed to do even that. I sit here, allowed to do nothing."

She starts to speak and then notices that Johann Spector is among you! Her eyes narrow and her fists clench. But before she can speak... ... Johann addresses her. "I know you do not remember me fondly, oh Queen," he says. "I was responsible for much evil. But I was insane at the time. Today, I accompany $P in an effort to undo the damage I have done." Her fists relax, but she does not exactly turn friendly. "We will see," she hisses. "But stay well away of me when not in the company of your noble friends."

50.name: Topuru
50.look: a skinny, white-haired, wide-eyed old native man.
50.hello: "Ha! It is a pale spirit from the water." He peers at you, looking you over. "Not a tribesman. Not a Sakkhra. Must be a spirit." He shoves out his hand, obviously expecting it to go right through you. It doesn't. He draws back, confused. "It is the spirit-stranger, the mind finder, the @turtle feeder, come back to see Topuru." "Has the spirit-stranger found Topuru's mind?" "It is the spirit-stranger, come to smash Topuru's skull, or give him food and call him 'friend.'"

qa.a: "What! Let Topuru see."
"Ah, the spirit-stranger is useless."
"Topuru has lost his name. No, that is wrong. Topuru has his name. It is Topuru. Topuru has lost his @mind."

51.name: Tristia
51.look: a beautiful but brooding woman in jaguar furs.
51.hello: "Why, it is a man. A tall, strange man wearing furs unlike any I have ever seen." She thinks about it a moment. "He must be $P. The @schweitzer of the Yolaru has told me of him." "What wants $P of Tristia?" Her question is half an invitation, half mockery. "It is $P, Tristia's mate." She spreads herself over you and kisses you passionately. "Tristia knew you would return. $P can never leave Tristia for long." "It is $P, who has cruelly spurned Tristia." She gives you an ugly look. "Do not speak to Tristia. She spurns YOU." "Why, what does Tristia see here? It is Aiela's favorite pet, $P." She

qa.a: "Tristia is the name this one bears."
"Tristia is daughter of the @chief. Tristia does no work. Work is for lesser ones, not for a princess."
"$P knows the schweitzer. $P walks with him." She points at Prof. Rafkin. "That is the schweitzer."

"Aloron is chief of the Kuraks and father of @Aiela. Aloron raised Tristia. Tristia's hut @burned and her mother and father died." She shrugs, unconcerned by that fact. Aiela leans over and whispers in your ear: "Aiela thinks Tristia set the fire herself. Tristia is a viper."

"Aiela is Tristia's sister. @Aloron raised both Aiela and Tristia." "Of course, Aloron likes Tristia MUCH more than Aiela." "Fortunately, Aiela has found a fitting mate in Darden the Huge. Tristia is sure the Urali tribe is a much better place for Aiela."
"Speak to Tristia of such things when Aiela is far away."
"This is the village of the Kurak tribe. Tristia is a princess of the Kuraks."
"$P must speak to Aloron about such things."
"Burn? Does $P like to burn things, too? Tristia loves to burn things."
"No, no, no. Travel with $P?" She laughs. "Tristia must stay here where it is safe. It is for others to travel and bring things back to Tristia."
"We will speak later, my mate."
She just shakes her head, looking disinterested.
She looks offended. "I have offered you Tristia, all that is Tristia. Do not refuse me, oh $P. Tristia is more beautiful than all others!" "Tristia asks again: Will $P love Tristia above all others?"

Her smile becomes victorious. She flows up to you, embraces you, and kisses you passionately. "$P is Tristia's mate now, and forever. Go and act as a mighty warrior, and always return to Tristia. Tristia's hut is next to the chief's. $P will never be cold there."

Her sigh is one of pure malice and victory. "Yes, mighty $P. Tristia is a much better mate than poor Aiela. She is full of fire." She struts up to you, pulls your head down to hers, and kisses you passionately, demonstrating that fire. "$P is Tristia's mate now, and forever. Go and act as a mighty warrior, and always return to Tristia. Tristia's hut is next to the chief's. $P will never be cold there."

Her expression turns to one of rage. "$P is a fool! $P does not deserve one as beautiful as Tristia. Go away, $P, and never speak to Tristia again!" She slaps you as hard as she can. Then she shakes, and her eyes roll up in her head... and she faints dead away.

52.name: Tuomaxx
52.look: a scowling, round man with a strange look in his eyes.
52.hello: The rotund man looks at you evilly and makes strange barking noises at you. "Oh, YOU again." "Oh, YOU again. "Oh, YOU again."

qa.a: He flutters his hand in front of your face and then pokes you in the eyes. "Tuomaxx. And don't forget it." (He pronounces it TWO-mash.)
"You remembered!"
From underneath his ragged garments he draws a pair of club-like weapons. "Tuomaxx makes @drums and drumsticks." To demonstrate, he brings one down on your head, which makes a ringing 'bonk' noise.
"I like drums! Drums are great! Drums are my life! You want me to make you one?"
"Tuomaxx was a member of the @Disquiqui tribe. Don't talk about them. Since Tuomaxx lost his @mind, Tuomaxx has lived alone."
"Tuomaxx said not to mention them!" He whacks you with his drumstick.
"Tuomaxx had a mind once. But a great foreign shanam -- er, shamam -- uh, shamozz -- witch doctor removed it." He points proudly to the unscarred surface of his bald head.
"No, thank you, Tuomaxx just ate."
"Hide? Is something fierce nearby?" He pulls his furs up over his head.
"Hill of the @Drum. Not far from Nahuatla stone city, northwest of city." He points east. He thinks about it and corrects, pointing south. "No, wait... this is the hill! Don't be so confusing!"
"You want a @really big drum, or the @biggest drum possible?"
"Ahhh, who needs you?"
"Huh?"
"You want a @small drum or a @large drum?"
"Wasting Tuomaxx' time, eh?" He whacks you with the drumstick.
He smacks himself on the forehead about a dozen times and shuffles his feet. "Tuomaxx asks again: You want a @small drum or a @large drum?"
With his drumsticks, he beats out a melodious tattoo on your forehead. "You want a @large drum or a @really large drum?"
"That's better." With his drumsticks, he beats out a melodious tattoo on your forehead. "You want a @large drum or a @really large drum?"
He sticks his face in yours and emits several short barking noises. "You want just a @really big drum or the @biggest drum?"
He grabs your earlobe and drags you around in a circle for a moment. Then he sticks his face in yours and emits several short barking noises. "You want just a @really big drum or the @biggest drum?"

"Well, why didn't you say so? Let Tuomaxx think." He struggles at it awhile. "Tuomaxx tries to think but nothing happens." Finally, he shrugs and gives up. "Wait! Tuomaxx has it. You must bring Tuomaxx @hide for drum-head. Then Tuomaxx can make biggest drum." He looks around him. "Only one place to build biggest drum. Do you know where that is?" He flutters his hand in front of his face, but now, wise to him, you block his attempt to poke your eyes. "That's right. Hill of the Drum. Right here. Bring Tuomaxx @hide for drum-head to @Hill of the Drum, and Tuomaxx will make biggest drum."
"Huh? What's a $Z?"
"Why not?"

53.name: Wamap
53.look: a pudgy, sly-eyed native with sallow skin.
53.hello: "What? Why, you are no Urali." He thinks about it. "Which means that you are an outsider clever enough to have found your way to our swamp." He thinks about it again, then twists his face into a smile. "I should wish to be YOUR friend." "Why, it is my friend, $P. You are ALWAYS welcome here." He smiles like a happy shark.

qa.a: "I am @Wamap, son of Wamash. That is my true name. You see, I have given you power over me by telling you my true name. I MUST be your friend."
"Ah, strange warrior learns quickly."

"I am shaman to the Urali. I listen to the spirits, especially the spirit @Fabozz, and interpret their will for the people." "In my youth, I was captured and raised among the Nahuatla. It is for this reason I am so much more educated than the other Urali, and better suited to lead them."
"But I have already told you all about that. Rescuing the statue of the Great @Fabozz, that is."

"Fabozz is the greatest of the spirits. He speaks to us through his statue. He is the master of animals. It is his spirit that commands the Mighty @Lizard which guards the crossing to our village." "And we are all so grateful to YOU for rescuing the Fabozz."
"Ehhh. I wish I could. But I have performed many, many healings already today, and my energies are depleted."
"But you already know all about Darden. You slew him."
"I do not know of what you speak, my dear, dear friend."
"Darden's only prisoner... recently... was the Kurak princess, Aiela. But you rescued her. And were amply rewarded for it, too, I am sure." He smirks.
"Yes, the statue. The statue of the Great @Fabozz." "You have already rescued it for us."
"We are the Urali. We are the most cunning of all the tribes of the Valley of Eodon. That is why we live in the swamp."
"I do not know of what you speak, my dear, dear friend."
"A Mighty Lizard, taller than the tallest hut, guards the only path from the Urali village to the outer swamplands... and the Valley of Eodon, beyond."
"Oh. Well, if you must."
"I do not know of what you speak, my dear, dear friend."

54.name: Xyxxxtl
54.look: the pale, bloated, grotesque queen of the Myrmidex.
54.hello: The white thing looks at you. Its mandibles clack in a semblance of human speech, obviously difficult for it. "Human-thing here!" it clacks. "Not-good not-good! Enemy warrior in nest! Chew up, chew up! Soldiers, destroy!" It looks at you again. "Meat-thing still here!" it clacks. "Save eggs! Save nest! Chew up meat-thing!"

55.name: Zipactriotl
55.look: a lean, dark-bearded man with shrewd eyes.
55.hello: He speaks to the party in perfect English: "Dr. Rafkin! How on Earth did you get here?" Astonished, Rafkin replies, "Dr. Spector, I presume..." "Yes, yes, man... of course I am! Now tell me! How did you get here?" Rafkin frowns, obviously put off by Dr. Spector's anger. "Well, I was performing some simple experiments on a black stone that $P here brought..." Dr. Spector grabs you by the shoulders and shakes you. He speaks to you in perfect English: "What on Earth -- you're not one of the natives! You're from the outside world! So am I." Suddenly he seizes you by the shoulders and shakes you. "

qa.a: He glares at you suspiciously. "Liar! No one such as yourself could possibly know how to leave, if even I could not find a way." "There is only one appropriate reward for arrogance such as yours." "Guards! Kill!"
He slumps back, looking defeated. "Then you are useless to me. Useless. What do you want?"
"I am Dr. Johann Schleimann Spector. The natives call me by the @Nahuatla equivalent, 'Zipactriotl.'" (He pronounces it Zee-pack-tree-OT-tl.)

"My former occupation is that of archaeologist." "I am currently the @shaman of these Nahuatla people. I tell them to shut up and worship me and the king." "I also give @permission to those who wish to speak to the king, Huitlapacti." "My next occupation... I will be the savior of Earth, the bringer of peace and @paradise."
"You want to hear about my plan to bring paradise to Earth?"

"They are a race of ant-like creatures... mutated to incredible size and intelligence by the power of the black stone in their possession." "I'm sure that a concerted effort on the part of the valley's primitive humans could destroy the Myrmidex." "Fortunately for my plans, the humans fight each other too much to @unite."

"Yes, this glow you see around me is a type of force field. I draw the energy from the mystic generators in the Underground City of the Kotl." "I've given a similar unit to the king, there, Huitlapacti. While we wear this glow, we are invulnerable to harm." He smiles mockingly.
"Do you mean the @old king or the @new king?"
"The new king is Huitlapacti. An idiot. Easily led. The people hate him. If he weren't protected by my force field, they'd rise up and kill him." "Would you like to speak to him?"
"The old king was Moctapotl. He wasn't willing to turn power over to me. So I deposed him; he ran away."

"Automatons. They're rather like statues... but animated by the mystic power from the generators in the Underground City of the Kotl." "The big ones are practically impervious to harm... and they take orders. They are the perfect army."

His eyes widen. "You mean to imply that I'm insane?" He shakes with anger. "Someone with your delusions would never willingly serve me. What to do, what to do." He snaps his fingers and looks much happier. "I've got it! I'll have you killed." He switches back to the native language. "Guards! Kill this!"
"I'm the shaman of these people. The witch-doctor. I had to get rid of the old shaman, @Oaxtepac. He didn't want to cooperate. I've still got him."
"These people you see around you are the Nahuatla. Proto-Aztecs, I'd call them. I believe they were brought here, to this land, from Central America some time in the distant past."
"The mystic generators in the Underground City of the Kotl supply me with power." "I can use that energy to travel back to the real world -- once I figure out how -- and to conquer the Earth."
"Uniting the tribes is about the only way to destroy the Myrmidex... other than by animating my automatons, of course." "But no one CAN unite the tribes, while I CAN animate my @automatons."
"There are many tribes out there. These Nahuatla are the most civilized of them."
"You want permission to speak to Huitlapacta?" He considers it. "You must @beg me for it." He smiles, enjoying his power.
He sighs deeply, enjoying himself. "Of course you may have permission," he says expansively. "Talk to him anytime you wish." He makes some hand-signal to one of the guards, who nods.

He frowns at you, considering. "You shouldn't be asking about my prisoners. You might just be thinking about rescuing him, mightn't you? Well, I'll soon put a stop to THAT." "Guards! Take this outside and cut its heart out!"
"The Underground City of the Kotl. It's..." He eyes you narrowly. "Don't bother asking me where it is, how to find it, or what it is. It's MY secret. You can't have it."
"You're in the valley of @Eodon, in the city of Tichticatl, in the Palace of the King."

"Yes, this valley. The natives call it Eodon. I believe it to be somewhere on Earth, but the mystical energies which permeate the valley have affected the passage of time, our observance of the stars, many other things." "So... frankly... I don't know where on Earth it is."
He waves his hand in a bored, dismissing gesture and turns his mind to other matters.
"Don't bother me with irrelevancies."
"Well, then." He looks miffed.

56.name: Kunawo
56.look: a balding, nearly toothless native man.
56.hello: "Kunawo hears a stranger, one strangers, warriors not of the Pindiro.& "Speak, say what you wish of Kunawo.& "Kunawo senses $P has returned. He is welcome in Kunawo's hut.& "Kunawo senses $P has returned, with companions. You are welcome within Kunawo's hut.&

qa.a: "Kunawo is this one's name.&
"Shaman of the Pindiro. @Trade with visitors. Speak with @spirits, advise chief. @Heal warriors. Many jobs.&
"You are among the @Pindiro.&
"The Pindiro are great warriors. Barako are our enemy.&
"Though Kunawo has lost the use of his eyes, Kunawo has other ways of seeing.&
"Fritz has chosen to live within the cave west of the great lake.&
He rocks slowly back and forth. "Kunawo has had dreams of monstrous creatures, great warriors. They kill and kill, without purpose. Myrmidex is the name that fills Kunawo's ears in these dreams.&
"Many Pindiro hunt fish from the waters. Use much @flax in making fishing strings. Kunawo will trade one pinde, chocolatl and yopo for five flax. But only with his fellow shamans.&
"I imagine he's talking about the fibers of the yucca plant, my boy. They would be a good source of flax.& The shaman nods. "The yucca will yield up its flaxen fibers easily.&
The ancient shaman tilts his head, as though listening to voices you cannot hear.

"There are many spirits. Spirits of the plains, animals, rivers. Many spirits. They speak to Kunawo.& "Kunawo speaks with chief and warriors. Tells them what spirits say.& "Often Kunawo must ask spirits to help him @heal sick or wounded tribesmen.&
"May the spirits protect you.&
"Kunawo does not know of this.&
"How many pinde?"
"How many yopo?"
"How many chocolatl?"

57.name: Paxaptamac
57.look: an intense looking man in native clothing.
57.hello: He looks over your clothing with a surprised expression. "Blessings of the spirits on the stranger. May I help you with something?" "Hello again, $P. I hope the spirits have been kind."

qa.a: "I am Paxaptamac."
"I make fine ornaments and feathered robes of the best @cloth." "Normally I would be able to @trade with you for something, but I recently finished a large feathered cloak, and my stock is depleted."
"This is the Nahuatla tribe. Most civilized of all the tribes." He grins at you. "Best dressed, too."
"As I said, I recently sold my last cloak, and it will take quite some time for me to make another... even if I had the @feathers I need."

"I use only the finest parrot feathers. When I was younger, I could go out and hunt parrots myself. A few minutes work on a dead parrot with my knife, and I could usually find several usable feathers." He looks at you thoughtfully for a moment. "If you were to bring me feathers, I would trade with you for them. One emerald for ten feathers."
"I will trade you one emerald for 10 parrot feathers."
"Using a loom on flax will produce cloth."
"I sometimes use blue stones in my ornaments. The @Barrab seem to have many of them."
"The Barrab live somewhere to the west, I hear."
He shakes his head. "I do not use any bones in my work."
"Cloth made from good @flax is wonderfully easy to work with. Soft, easily sewn, easily decorated. Much better than the simple @hides some tribes use."
"@Yucca plants are a good source of flax, though it can be quite tedious to collect enough for a good garment."
"Most of them have reddish orange flowers. There are a couple out behind my shop."
"Many of the more primitive tribes use hides as clothing. I find @cloth much easier to work with."
"King Moctapotl is once again upon the throne. He was in exile, but when we found that Huitlapacti was truly mortal..." he shudders. "Huitalpacti will trouble none of us again."
"I have heard of the Myrmidex, but I have never seen one. I hope I never do!"
"Huitalpacti is dead, at last. The Nahuatla are happier for his passing."
"May the spirits follow you, $P."
"I do not understand what you say."
"Ah, good! Let me see just how many you have brought for me."
"Ah well," he sighs. "Perhaps another time, then."
"That's the best price I can offer. Perhaps another day. What else can I help you with?"

58.name: Seggalion
58.look: a germanic man wearing worn modern clothes.
58.hello: Cautiously, he waits for you to speak.

qa.a: He eyes you suspiciously. "It's Seggalion."
"I don't know if I should tell you or not..." "I'm searching for @diamonds."
"I knew I shouldn't have told you! Now you'll try to get them first!"
He looks at you suspiciously. "You're not looking for modules, are you?"
"I've met him, a time or two. What's it to you?"
He looks askance at Shamuru. "Never heard of him. Nope. Never." "He looked familiar... I've seen that face before, somewhere."
He glares at you angrily. "That's NOT my name!"
He shudders, as though from a bad memory. "That was a terrible place. Never did like dogs, anyway."
"I don't know anyone named Fritz."
"Work.... work.... The greatest joy is work....." "Arbeit macht frei!"
"Ah... I have heard of the Great And Powerful Allston."
"If you ain't Steve, you ain't shit."
"Don't listen to him, he's always putting words in people's mouths!"
"Squawrk!"
"Love those wiper-weasels!"
"Bob? He said something about getting some sleep. I wouldn't disturb him... he had a gun."
"Go, Oilers!&
"Jason? He's fired!"
"Get back to work!"
"Glen? What? He still owes me money!"
"Goodbye. Leave me in peace."
"What are you talking about?"

64.name: Barako
64.look: a rugged-looking native dressed in bear skins.
64.hello: "It is $P, who saved young Halisa! Welcome." The native stares at you: Not rudely, but cautiously. "Another @stranger in Barako lands."

qa.a: "Member of Barako tribe."

"Barako." The native seems to warm to the subject. "We live in the mountains and protect ourselves from the cold with heavy furs." "We war with the @Pindiro. There are also @strangers in our lands, strangers who are not enemies." "Our ruler is @Halawa, a queen of great wisdom and cunning. Our greatest warrior is @Shamuru."
"Halawa is ruler of the Barako. Her mother was queen before her. It is our way: The Barako have queens instead of kings."
"Halisa has spoken much of the kindness of her rescuer, oh $P."
"$N knows little of the Barako shaman. He has been gone for many, many days. $N fears he may not return."

The native bows to Shamuru. "The great hunter is with you now." Shamuru nods in return. "Shamuru will be travelling with $P for some time; tell the others of the tribe." "As Shamuru wishes." "Shamuru is the name of the greatest hunter of the Barako. Shamuru travels the valley, learning all of its paths and secrets. Shamuru is more at home in the wild than with his tribe."
"Do you mean @Shaman or @Shamuru?"
"There are two strangers in these lands. One is @old and the other @young. Which did you mean?"
"On an island west of the Barako village lives an old man named Topuru. Topuru is mad, always speaking of rocks. He stays away from the Barako."

"In the northeast part this valley lives a strange man -- strange like you. His furs are odd and he speaks oddly." "He says his name is Frit-azz. There is much more to his name but it is impossible to remember. He says he comes from far away."
"The Pindiro live north and east of us, by a lake. They live on the plains and hunt plains-beasts."
"May the spirits save you from falling."
"I know not of $Z."

65.name: Barrab
65.look: a somewhat Asian-looking native in heavy furs.

qa.a: "This one's name is $N."
"$N hunts and gathers for the Barrab tribe, dwellers of the @mesa."
"$N belongs to the Barrab tribe, dwellers on the @mesa. Our chief is @Balakai, and @Nakai is our prince. The Barrabs are enemies of the @Sakkhra."
"Balakai is chief of the Barrab, and shaman. Balakai's wisdom is great."
Quietly the native says "She is about here, somewhere."

"There are three mesas in the western parts of the valley. One is the Mesa of the Barrab, where this one lives. North of our village is the Lesser Mesa, where no one lives and little grows." "Further north is the Great Mesa, largest of the three, where only beasts and plants live."
The native's face loses all expression. "Such things are best discussed with the Barrab chieftain, who is @Balakai."

"Ah! Sakkhra. Lizards in the shape of men. Fierce warriors indeed. Sakkhra and Barrab have been enemies for many generations." "Sakkhra dwell in caves west of the Great Mesa. Once they dwelt further north. $N does not know why the Sakkhra left their ancient caves for their new dwellings."
"$N has heard of the Myrmidex. Fierce beasts to the far east. $N has heard that when the eastern tribes fall, the Myrmidex will next come for the Barrab and the @Sakkhra."
"$N knows of the Barrab warrior named Nawl. $N thinks it is best that Nawl keep well away from the Barrab mesa. Nawl is both a braggart and a fool."
"Nakai is son of the chieftain, Balakai."
"That is something to speak of with the @chieftain, not with this poor, humble one."
"$N bids fare well."
"$N knows anguish, for $N does not understand those words."
"Ah." The native beams. "$N was certain it was so. Welcome is the mighty $P among the Barrab."
"Oh." The native looks faintly confused. "$N was in error."
"Ny mame is $N. At leasht, it was this morning."
"$N doesn't have one of those." $N looks puzzled, trying to figure out what a 'job' is.

"Thish is the Disquiqui tribe. Our chief is @Chafblum and our shaman is @Larrifin. Disquiqui are the greatesht of the tribes." "We make war on no one. But we DO have a prisoner. $N doesn't know how we got a prisoner without making war, but we did. Its name is @Jim-my."
"Our chaf is Chiefblum. Uh, our chief is Chafblum. (Hic!) Strong warrior, mighty leader. Chafblum is around the feasht shomewhere."

"Moctapickle? Oh, yes... that sad Nahuatla king. He stayed here for a while. Never drank enough. Was always sad about something." He's always sitting around in the village, moaning about his exile or something. He's no fun."
"Oh, yes, we Disquiqui are the best paddle makers. Many people use our paddles, some even use them with rafts! We use them for making pulque. Have to. Make lots of @pulque."
"Pulque is good drink. Very good drink. Very very good drink. Pulque almost like food, but better."
"Disquiqui shaman is called Larrifin. Larrifin is very good shaman. Though he does not know anything about healing. Or invoking the spirits."

"Guoblum's mate-to-be has a name like that. Skinny, noisy warrior from far away." "Skinny? SKINNY? Why, I oughta --" "Oh, there Jimmy is." "$N thinks he is in hut in Disquiqui village somewhere. Look around." The native vaguely waves in the direction of the village.
"Oh, you were boring anyway."
"Who is $Z?"
"Uhhh. Haakur. Uhhh." "From what little I can make out, $P, only the most important people of the Haakur tribe are granted names."
It struggles to speak, and manages a few painful-sounding words: "@Haakur. Tribe. Warrior."
"Haakur." It slaps itself. "Haakur tribe."
"Chief. Grugorr. Find. Haakur. @Caves."
"Cave."
"Kill. Myrm. Dex."
"Uhhh. Uhhh."
It shakes its head, not understanding.

68.name: Jukari
68.look: a rugged-looking native in shaggy hides.
68.hello: "$P, who returned to us the sacred hide, is welcome in Jukari lands." "Beware, stranger: This is Jukari land."

qa.a: "$N gathers food for the Jukari tribe, and protects the young and weak from the @Haakur."
"$N is of the Jukari tribe. We live in the land of the shaking earth, where @rock flows like water and the spirits are fiercest."
"We have no shaman. Old shaman crushed by stones. Must have failed to please mountain spirits."
"The Haakur are ugly men living to the northeast. They live in caves and are brutes."
"Rock that flows from the mountains, glows at night. Killed our old @chief. There are also pools of hot @sulphur.&
"The new chief is named Jumu. Jumu's father Kumaru died under a flow of hot rock, mere days ago."
"There are diamonds in this land. But that is a question for the chief."
"There are pits of sulphur in this land. Travel about and you will find them."
"Go, then, and return any time you wish to come in peace."
"That is a question for the chief."

69.name: Kurak
69.look: a noble savage wearing the furs of a great cat.

qa.a: "$P may call me $N.&
"$N is a member of the @Kurak tribe.& "$N helps to search for @Aiela, who has been captured by the Urali tribe.&
"We are the Kuraks. We are one with the jungle. We are the greatest tribe, for great are our enemies, the @Yolaru and the @Myrmidex.& "And recently, the @Urali.&
"There is none here. $N believes there is some to the southeast, east of the stone city of the @Nahuatlas.&
"The Nahuatla are a foolish tribe who live away from the spirits; they build their huts of stone and cover the earth with more stone. Their village is all of stone. It is to the southeast.&
"It is easy to make hides. $P must find a mighty beast of the jungle and slay it in single combat. Then he must use his knife on its carcass to cut free its hide.&
"Yolaru are fierce black warriors, noble in combat, a fit and proper enemy for the Kuraks. They live to the east of the Kuraks.&

$N scowls. "The Myrmidex are no fit enemy. They are insects the size of warriors. They are fierce and treacherous.& "They live only to kill, and may only be killed; they know no thought or reason. Their nest is close to the Kurak village, to the west.&

"$N has heard of one with a name such as that. He is a prisoner in the village of the Disquiqui, to the far southwest. He awaits marriage to the chief's daughter Guoblum.& "Not any more, pal! Super-Bachelor is free once again.&
$N starts to speak, but... ... Prof. Rafkin cuts $N off. "Not nice to talk about someone right in front of his face, my boy. At least wait for me to turn my back, so you can talk behind it.&
$N shrugs. "$N does not know what that word means, either.&
"$N knows of the Urali. They live far away, to the southeast.& "It was Urali warriors who had taken Aiela away. But $P has rescued our princess.&

"$N has heard the story of one called Topuru. Topuru is supposed to be one of the @Urali, but a madman. Topuru lives near the Barako, across the deep river canyon to the north, on a little island, all alone.&
"Aiela is princess of the Kuraks, most beautiful woman of the tribe. She is held by Darden the Huge, chief of the @Urali tribe.&

"There is a legend that once all the tribes were united for a time.& "A warrior called Oloro-of-No-Tribe brought the tribes together to fight the lizards of the jungle when the lizards were too numerous and too deadly.& "Oloro went from chieftain to chieftain. By his strength and spirit Oloro persuaded each chief to join his union.& "Then Oloro built a great drum to summon all the tribes together. Oloro beat upon the drum and all the tribes came, slaying the lizards. Thus were the tribes united... once.&
"May the spirits guard your path, $P.&
"$N does not understand your words, $P.&

70.name: Nahuatla
70.hello: "Yes? What do you wish of me, outsider?&

qa.a: "My name only pales beside yours, oh $P, conquerer of Huitlapacti, restorer of Moctapotl.&
"I am a citizen of Tichticatl. I tend the fields, transport grain, work on @crafts, elude the @thunder-lizards and @Myrmidex in the field; we all do.&
"Atlipacta is our swordmaker. She has a shop just west of the main plaza where the sundial sits.&
"Yes, there is supposed to be bamboo growing thick, some ways to the east of Tichticatl.&
"Emeralds are highly prized in Tichticatl.&
"I am a citizen of the Nahuatla, the builders of this great city of Tichticatl.& The native's gesture takes in the entire city.
"Bones. Have I not heard of some great collection of bones? Yes. North of the giant @bamboo stand, there is a place where the @thunder-lizards go to die. There you can find bones.&
$N spits. "That for the memory of Huitlapacti.& "All hail our new king Huitlapacti.& The native's voice is fearful.
"Many of us make @pots sometimes. We have a fine @weapon maker in Tichticatl, and our @weaver makes very nice clothes and ornaments.&
"Paxaptamac the weaver lives a short distance west of the pyramid of the sun.&
"Many of us own nice pots. You could make your own, if you were to use some @clay to form it, then fire it in a @kiln.&
"One can get clay from the riverbanks, with a @digging stick.&
The native looks slightly puzzled. "Yes, a digging stick. A small stick specially carved digging roots and clay.&
"There is a kiln along the south edge of Tichticatl.&
"The tall stone structure at the eastern end of Tichticatl. There is a sun-dial at it's peak.&

"You know -- the great lizards of the jungle and the field.& "This native is collectively referring to dinosaurs and other prehistoric reptiles, $P. DO pay attention.& The native looks puzzled, but does not comment.
"It sounds as though you wish to see the weapon-maker, Atlipacta. She crafts weapons in a shop near the palace, just west of the pyramid of the sun.&
"You speak of our king, whom you yourself restored to the throne.&
"The Myrmidex? Evil monsters from the northwest. They are like ants the size of a man, and they attack us without mercy. The fields are no longer a safe place to work.&
"I have heard of the Urali. They are a savage race. They raid Tichticatl, coming in from the northeast, but I know not where they live.&
"May the spirits guide you.&
"I do not understand your words. What is a '$Z'?&
"Good.&

The native looks nervously all around to see if anyone is listening, then leans in close. "The new king, Huitlapacti, has decreed that no one say that name. It is the name of the old king.& "To speak that name is death, for the old king is alive, living out in the jungle somewhere, planning his return. This is why the name is not to be spoken.&

71.name: Pindiro
71.look: a lean, tanned native wearing very little.
71.hello: The native nods. "$N welcomes $P, maker of peace." The native stands back, eyeing you cautiously.

qa.a: "$N hunts on the vast Pindiro plains, @fishes in the lakes and rivers."
"$N is of the Pindiro tribe, the plains-runners, @fishers , enemies of the @Barako ."
"The Pindiro queen is named Inara."
"Pindoro catch many fish from the rivers and @lake."
The native points vaguely to the north. "The big lake. Sometimes use @rafts to fish away from shore."
The native looks at you impatiently. "Logs, tied together. Must have four people with @paddles to use raft."
"@Disquiqui make many paddles. Sometimes we trade for them."
"Yes, Disquiqui. Strange tribe... do not fight. Live far away, west of stone city." "Must get back to work."
"The Barako tribe lives to the west, near many waterfalls. The Pindiro and Barako are enemies from ancient times."
"Spirits guide your steps."
The native shrugs, not understanding.

72.name: Sakkhra
72.look: a man-shaped reptile with intelligence in its eyes.
72.hello: The thing eyes you suspiciously. "Yesss, huuuman?"

qa.a: It hisses something at you. It doesn't sound menacing. But if that's its name, there's no way you could say it.
"Thisss one ssseeksss food for the young of the @Sakkhra. Tries to thiink of way to ssslay @Thunderer."
"Yesss, Thunderer. Enormousss liizard. Kills and eatsss @Sakkhra who go to the grove of @medicine trees."
"Trees with green fruit. Good medicine for Sakkhra."
"Barraaab huumans. Live eassst of Sakkhra caaaves."
"Sakkhra. Sssmartessst of all ssscaly ones. Ssstronger than huumans. Chief is caaalled @Sysskarr."
"Yesss, Sysskarr. Chief of Sakkhra. Ooold and wiise."
"Eeevil! Insssects. Enemies of aaaall."
"Aaasssk @Sysskarr about thaaat."
"Ssssss."
"Not underssstaaand."

73.name: Urali
73.hello: The native stays at a safe distance and remains cautious. "What does the stranger want?" The native gives you a cautious, appraising look; then a broad smile breaks out on the native's face. "It is you, the $P one who slew @Darden. You are a friend to Urali. Ask what you will of me."

qa.a: "My name is pale and weak beside yours, oh $P. I do not wish to utter it and be ashamed. Let it be enough that I am one of the Urali."
"I hunt, and fish, and gather plants to eat; I harvest our lovely swamp, as do all @Urali."

"We are the Urali. Mighty in war. Defended and fed by our mother, the swamp, which is bountiful to the Urali, dangerous to all @others." "We Urali know all the @trails and paths through the swamp, which you would never find." "Wamap "@Darden is our chieftain."
"You do not need to know our secret trails, oh $P. You are already friend of the Urali and have nothing to fear here."

"The Great Fabozz is a spirit of the Valley of Eodon. His are the virtues of courage and strength as the animals possess them." "It is the Great Fabozz who commands the Mighty Lizard which guards the pathway to the Urali village. But our @statue of Fabozz has been taken by @Darden the Huge. "
"I know you are the friend of the Urali. If you were not, you would not have slain Darden the Huge."
"I do not understand you."
"I do not understand you." "You cannot be neither! You are either Darden's @friend or Darden's @enemy!"
"Darden the Huge. The old chief died childless, so his sister's son Darden became chief, not long ago." "He was evil and cruel. But now things are better. Darden is dead."

"The Myrmidex are beasts, more savage than any man, or even Urali. They live far away from the Urali. But they will come for the Urali some day. It would be good if tribes would @unite to fight them. The Myrmidex are too fierce for the Urali."
"Do you speak of Darden's prisoner @Aiela, or his spirit-prisoner, the Great @Fabozz?"

"Darden stole the statue of the Great @Fabozz. It commands the Mighty Lizard which guards the Urali village." "Darden told the Urali that Darden would make the Mighty Lizard destroy the Urali if Darden were not made chieftain. So we made him chief." The native sounds sad. "@Darden used his big riding lizard to take the statue deep into the cave, where light could not reach. Many warriors have brought light to Fabozz, but our torches and fires are not enough." The native brightens. "But that is all over. The Great Fabozz is once again where he belongs, thanks to you."
"There is tar here, in the swamp valley. On the west side of the swamp water, south of the land bridge that leads to the Urali village, is a great tar pit."
"Topuru was one of the Urali once, shaman to the Urali. Topuru angered the shaman of a faraway tribe and was driven mad. I have never seen him since."
"I do not understand you."

"I do not know many of the tribes. Outside our swamp valley, nearby, there are the Yolaru to the north; they are black-skinned warriors, very fierce." "Beyond them, to the northwest, there are the Kurak, cunning in the forests." "South of the Yolaru, there are the Nahuatla, who build their city of stone." "And west of the Nahuatla, down below, are the Disquiqui, who fight poorly but live merry lives." "There are more tribes besides those, but I do not know them."
"Unite the tribes? If it can be done, it is for the chiefs to decide." "Since Darden is dead, our chief is the shaman Wamap. Travel the swamp and speak to all; you will find Wamap."
"Aiela, Princess of the Kuraks. @Darden coveted her. Darden captured and imprisoned her." "But you have freed her."
"May the spirits protect you... so long as you do not seek to harm the Urali."
"I do not understand you."
The native sighs. "I have asked too much of you. I should know better. And Fabozz must remain a prisoner in Fabozz' cavern @prison."
"$N is member of Yolaru tribe. There are many @other tribes.&
"$N is warrior and gatherer of food, as are all Yolaru.&
"Iron bamboo? South of place of bones.&
"You want bone? Easy to find. Go south from Yolaru village. Walk at bottom of cliff. You will find place of many bones. Do not enter caves. Dangerous animals there.&
"Anyone can get hide. Kill large beast. Use knife on body. Then have hide.& The Yolaru looks contemptuous of your ignorance in this matter.
"Have heard of such. @Disquiqui have it.& Jimmy breaks in: "Not any more, they don't!" "Disquiqui HAD it.&
"Nahuatla call their stone city Tichticatl. One day's travel south of Yolaru village.&
"Disquiqui. Stupid tribe. Drink, sing all time.& "Find Disquiqui? Go to city of stone where @Nahuatla live. Take path south to foot of cliff. Go west. Find Disquiqui there.&
"Warrior of @Nahuatla. Once chieftain there. Have heard he lives with @Disquiqui now.&
"Antlike beast. Strong, fierce, hungry, evil. Yolaru hate Myrmidex more than anything. But cannot beat Myrmidex. Myrmidex always win.&

"Rafkin came to our tribe. We captured. Was not angry, did not fight. Showed us healing. Showed us many things.& "We said, 'You will be our shaman.' He said, 'No, your shaman is good. I will be your schweitzer.' We do not know what schweitzer is, but Rafkin is our @schweitzer.&
"You wish to speak to our schweitzer, who is called @Rafkin?"
"Tuomaxx. Drum-maker. Disquiqui sent him away. He was strange.& "You want him? Follow path south from Yolaru village. Keep to the west, and you should find a hill. Tuomaxx lives there.&
"Urali warriors. Attack, steal women from all tribes. Only since Darden the Huge became chief there. When they attack Yolaru village, always come from east or southeast.&
"You wish to unite tribes?" The warrior looks doubtful. "Too long fighting. Do not think you can. Speak to @chiefs if you wish to try. I am not chief.&
"Yolaru chief is Apaton. Find him in Yolaru @village.&
"Yolaru village is north of stone city of @Nahuatla. Find stone city, go north. Cannot fail to see it.&
"You want drum? Find @Tuomaxx.&
"Chief of @Urali. Big, evil. Mighty warrior.&

"There are many tribes in valley. $N's tribe is Yolaru. Nearby are Kurak and @Disquiqui, pale-skins, and @Nahuatla, with skin like copper.& "Farther away... @Urali. Pindiro. Barrab. Barako. Jukari. Haakur, ugly men. Sakkhra, lizards who walk like men. Do not know much about these tribes.& "Do not know YOUR tribe at all.&
"Fare well. Watch out for great lizards.&
"Cannot help you.&

75.name: Naguard
75.look: a strapping warrior in Aztec-like clothing.
75.hello: "It is the mighty $P. I have heard much of you.& "What are you doing here? You are an intruder! You must die by my knife!&

qa.a: "Goodbye, friend $P.&
"I cannot speak to you while I am on duty, mighty $P. I am sorry.&

76.name: Uraguard
76.look: a sallow-skinned male warrior with suspicious eyes.
76.hello: "Ah! It is $P, mighty slayer of Darden the Huge. $P is a friend to the Urali." "A stranger! An enemy of the Urali! I must kill him -- so Darden commands!" "Ah! It is $P, who rescued the Great Fabozz! $P is welcome here."

qa.a: "Among the Urali, true names are not so freely given. You may call me 'friend.'"
"This one is a warrior and guard of the Urali."
"May the spirits watch over you, $P."
"This warrior is on duty. Guarding. $P should speak to those who are not guarding." He looks apologetic but does not answer your question.
"Yes, yes, yes, yes. Wants a cracker."
"With this beak?"
"No handles allowed!" SQUAWK!
"I don't watch that show!"
"If we all pull together, we parrots are bound to be able to drop a boulder on that @Tyrannosaurus!"
"Parrot eater!" SQUAWK!
"Feed me!"
"Spam spam spam!" SQUAWK! "Humbug!"
"No anchovies!"
"Parrots can't read!" SQUAWK!
"Pretty kitty!"
"Big kitty!"
"Rock the vote! SQUAWK!"
The parrot looks at you in a frigtened manner, then flies to a higher branch and squawks over its shoulder "Hurry up with that boulder!"
"Bye! Ingrate! SQUAWK!"

78.name: Wisp
78.look: a strange, floating ball of glowing light.
78.hello: "Once more 'you' of Earth address 'I' of the Xorinite dimension." "At this progression point in the temporal continuity, how do 'you' wish to be addressed?"

qa.a: "Excellent. This obviates the need for reiteration of previous declarations of origin, intent, and activity. What shall 'we' speak of?"

"Unfortunate. Repetition of previously-discussed information required. 'You' must sometime learn to extend perception along 'your' temporal continuity to avoid such confusion." "The manifestation before 'you' is a life-form projection from the Xorinite dimension." "'I' of Xorinia communicate with the bipedal organic units of Earth through this projection." "'I' observe activity at various points along Earth's temporal axis. In wealthier dimensions 'I' trade information, but 'you' of Earth have never offered any of significant value." "'My' projections are at this point in space time primarily to allow 'me' to observe and analyze the surrounding space-time @anomaly. What do 'you' wish to know, '$9'?"

"'I' do not utilize the communications function referred to as 'name'. On Earth, any of my projections is referred to as 'wisp'." "If the manifestation '$9' must use a 'name' to remain functional, it may use 'wisp'."
"Correct."
"A subset of the more general superset of bipedal organic units. A primitive example of the more complete evolutionary point of which 'I' am an example."
"That is correct. We are on Earth."

"Xorinia acts as a conduit for information between different continua, planes, dimensions. Xorinia also retains information which will improve Xorinia." "The manifestation in proximity of '$9' is at location 'here-now' to observe energy @anomalies."

"The geographical superset commonly referred to by its local bipedal manifestations as 'valley' and 'Eodon' and 'here' is a source of energy stress." "A @power source of significant relative magnitude exerts considerable distorting influence on this space-time region." "Analysis of the situation indicates that at some temporal point in the 'past' an energy source bearing the Britannian vocal referent 'moonstone' embedded itself in this proximity." "@Modification of the energies of said 'moonstone' have resulted in the geographical superset 'here-now' 'Eodon' 'Valley' being placed outside the normal space-time continuum." "Life-units which in other 'here-now' positions have ceased to manifest on both individual and collective bases have adapted to the distortion by continuing to exist in both individual and collective senses." "Continuing stress on the space-time continuum by the damaged 'moonstone' has resulted in scattering of small but volatile @distortions all through the space-time continuum."

"Stresses from power source called 'moonstone' exert tremendous influence on the space-time continuum. This results in ripples and holes in the continuum." "This can create temporary points of intersection between space-time points -- that is, 'places' -- which should customarily enjoy no contact." "Left uncorrected, this situation can permanently distort and blend space-time regions, perhaps @destroying them."

"Object containing the distorting energy is similar to objects which are called 'moonstones' in the dimension 'Britannia.'" "This one has been subtly altered, and differs from other examples of its type in ways your language has no words for." "Vocal interpretations of its physical state of being result in the words 'black' and 'stone'." "Amounts of power indicated that the referent 'large' or 'enormous' should also be appended."

"Available data indicate that life-forms studying the power source 'moonstone' enacted energies upon it, modifying it beyond its original scope." "These modifications have resulted in distortions to the space-time continuum."
"Unchecked emission of energies from power-source 'moonstone' can result in blending, blurring, and ultimately destruction of large regions of the @multiverse."
"'Multiverse' is a word-referent of your life-form; it signifies all reality in all universes."

"Where is a 'you' word-referent interrogative requesting data on space-time coordinates, correct?" "It is impossible to relate space-time coordinates as this manifestation grasps them to coordinates as the life-form 'you' understands them."

"It is redundant for 'you' to make notification of 'your' intent to move to different spatial points." "A short trip forward on the time continuum reveals that intent much more precisely. However, in the manner of 'your' life-form: 'Good-bye.'" "The information 'I' have just given 'you' can be considered a free sample. If 'you' offer 'me' valuable information at a point further along the time continuum, 'I' will present 'you' with information of true value."
"The communications form 'you' refer to as 'language' is too inexact and interpretive. This manifestation cannot answer 'your' interrogative."
